<h1 id="eth-beacon-node-api">Eth Beacon Node API vDev - Ethereum Proof-of-Stake Consensus Specification v1.7.0-beta.3</h1>

> Scroll down for code samples, example requests and responses. Select a language for code samples from the tabs above or the mobile navigation menu.

API specification for the beacon node, which enables users to query and participate in Ethereum 2.0 phase 0 beacon chain.

The schemas in this specification assume the `mainnet` preset from the consensus specifications.

All requests by default send and receive JSON, and as such should have either or both of the "Content-Type: application/json"
and "Accept: application/json" headers.  In addition, some requests can send and receive data in the SSZ format.  The header
"Content-Type: application/octet-stream" should be set in requests that contain SSZ data; a preference to receive SSZ data in
response can be indicated by setting the "Accept: application/octet-stream;q=1.0,application/json;q=0.9" header.  Note that
only a subset of requests can respond with data in SSZ format; these are noted in each individual request.

When handling requests, the server should return a 415 status code if the "Content-Type" header in the request specifies a format
that is not supported.  Similarly, it should return a 406 status code if it cannot produce a response in the format accepted by
the client as specified in the "Accept" header; if no "Accept" header is provided then it is assumed to be "application/json".
In any case, the server should indicate the format of the response by setting the corresponding "Content-Type" header.

API endpoints are individually versioned.  As such, there is no direct relationship between all v1 endpoints, all v2 endpoints,
_etc._ and no such relationship should be inferred.  All JSON responses return the requested data under a `data` key in the top
level of their response.  Additional metadata may or may not be present in other keys at the top level of the response, dependent
on the endpoint.  The rules that require an increase in version number are as follows:

  - no field that is listed in an endpoint shall be removed without an increase in the version number
  - no field that is listed in an endpoint shall be altered in terms of format (_e.g._ from a string to an array) without an
    increase in the version number

Note that it is possible for a field to be added to an endpoint's data or metadata without an increase in the version number.

Base URLs:

* <a href="http://localhost/">http://localhost/</a>

Web: <a href="https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-apis/issues">Ethereum Github</a> 
License: <a href="https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/">CC0-1.0</a>

<h1 id="eth-beacon-node-api-beacon">Beacon</h1>

Set of endpoints to query beacon chain.

## Retrieve details of the chain's genesis.

<a id="opIdgetGenesis"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/genesis \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/genesis`

Retrieve details of the chain's genesis which can be used to identify chain.

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "genesis_time": "1590832934",
    "genesis_validators_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
    "genesis_fork_version": "0x00000000"
  }
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "Chain genesis info is not yet known"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="retrieve-details-of-the-chains-genesis-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Request successful|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Chain genesis info is not yet known|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="retrieve-details-of-the-chains-genesis-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|object|true|none|none|
|» genesis_time|[GenesisTime](#schemagenesistime)|true|none|The genesis_time configured for the beacon node, which is the unix time in seconds at which the Eth2.0 chain began.|
|» genesis_validators_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|none|
|» genesis_fork_version|[ForkVersion](#schemaforkversion)|true|none|a fork version number|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get state SSZ HashTreeRoot

<a id="opIdgetStateRoot"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/root \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/root`

Calculates HashTreeRoot for state with given 'stateId'. If stateId is root, same value will be returned.

<h3 id="get-state-ssz-hashtreeroot-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state_id|path|string|true|State identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", "justified", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded stateRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": {
    "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid state ID: current"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "State not found"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-state-ssz-hashtreeroot-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid state ID|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|State not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-state-ssz-hashtreeroot-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|object|true|none|none|
|» root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|HashTreeRoot of BeaconState object|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/finality_checkpoints`

## Get validators from state

<a id="opIdgetStateValidators"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/validators \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/validators`

Returns filterable list of validators with their balance, status and index.

Information will be returned for all indices or public key that match known validators.  If an index or public key does not
match any known validator, no information will be returned but this will not cause an error.  There are no guarantees for the
returned data in terms of ordering; both the index and public key are returned for each validator, and can be used to confirm
for which inputs a response has been returned.


<h3 id="get-validators-from-state-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state_id|path|string|true|State identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", "justified", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded stateRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|
|id|query|[string]|false|Either hex encoded public key (any bytes48 with 0x prefix) or validator index|
|status|query|[[ValidatorStatus](#schemavalidatorstatus) \| string]|false|[Validator status specification](https://hackmd.io/ofFJ5gOmQpu1jjHilHbdQQ)|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "index": "1",
      "balance": "1",
      "status": "active_ongoing",
      "validator": {
        "pubkey": "0x93247f2209abcacf57b75a51dafae777f9dd38bc7053d1af526f220a7489a6d3a2753e5f3e8b1cfe39b56f43611df74a",
        "withdrawal_credentials": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "effective_balance": "1",
        "slashed": false,
        "activation_eligibility_epoch": "1",
        "activation_epoch": "1",
        "exit_epoch": "1",
        "withdrawable_epoch": "1"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid state ID: current"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "State not found"
}
```

> 414 Response

```json
{
  "code": 414,
  "message": "Too many validator IDs in request"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-validators-from-state-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid state or validator ID, or status|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|State not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|414|URI Too Long|Too many validator IDs|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-validators-from-state-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[[ValidatorResponse](#schemavalidatorresponse)]|true|none|none|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get validators from state

<a id="opIdpostStateValidators"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/validators \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "ids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "statuses": [
      "active_ongoing"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/validators`

Returns filterable list of validators with their balance, status and index.

Information will be returned for all indices or public key that match known validators.  If an index or public key does not
match any known validator, no information will be returned but this will not cause an error.  There are no guarantees for the
returned data in terms of ordering; both the index and public key are returned for each validator, and can be used to confirm
for which inputs a response has been returned.

The POST variant of this endpoint has the same semantics as the GET endpoint but passes
the lists of IDs and statuses via a POST body in order to enable larger requests.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "statuses": [
    "active_ongoing"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-validators-from-state-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state_id|path|string|true|State identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", "justified", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded stateRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|
|body|body|object|true|The lists of validator IDs and statuses to filter on. Either or both may be `null` to signal that no filtering on that attribute is desired.|
|» ids|body|[string]|false|An array of values, with each value either a hex encoded public key (any bytes48 with 0x prefix) or a validator index.<br><br>If the supplied list is empty (i.e. the value is `[]`) or the property is omitted then all validators will be returned.<br>|
|» statuses|body|[[ValidatorStatus](#schemavalidatorstatus) \| string]|false|An array of validator statuses to filter on.<br><br>If the supplied list is empty (i.e. the value is `[]`) or the property is omitted then validators with all statuses will be returned.<br>|
|» » *oneOf*|body|[ValidatorStatus](#schemavalidatorstatus)|false|Possible statuses:<br>- **pending_initialized** - When the first deposit is processed, but not enough funds are available (or not yet the end of the first epoch) to get validator into the activation queue.<br>- **pending_queued** - When validator is waiting to get activated, and have enough funds etc. while in the queue, validator activation epoch keeps changing until it gets to the front and make it through (finalization is a requirement here too).<br>- **active_ongoing** - When validator must be attesting, and have not initiated any exit.<br>- **active_exiting** - When validator is still active, but filed a voluntary request to exit.<br>- **active_slashed** - When validator is still active, but have a slashed status and is scheduled to exit.<br>- **exited_unslashed** - When validator has reached regular exit epoch, not being slashed, and doesn't have to attest any more, but cannot withdraw yet.<br>- **exited_slashed** - When validator has reached regular exit epoch, but was slashed, have to wait for a longer withdrawal period.<br>- **withdrawal_possible** - After validator has exited, a while later is permitted to move funds, and is truly out of the system.<br>- **withdrawal_done** - (not possible in phase0, except slashing full balance) - actually having moved funds away<br><br>[Validator status specification](https://hackmd.io/ofFJ5gOmQpu1jjHilHbdQQ)<br>|
|» » *oneOf*|body|string|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» » *oneOf*|pending_initialized|
|» » *oneOf*|pending_queued|
|» » *oneOf*|active_ongoing|
|» » *oneOf*|active_exiting|
|» » *oneOf*|active_slashed|
|» » *oneOf*|exited_unslashed|
|» » *oneOf*|exited_slashed|
|» » *oneOf*|withdrawal_possible|
|» » *oneOf*|withdrawal_done|
|» » *oneOf*|active|
|» » *oneOf*|pending|
|» » *oneOf*|exited|
|» » *oneOf*|withdrawal|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "index": "1",
      "balance": "1",
      "status": "active_ongoing",
      "validator": {
        "pubkey": "0x93247f2209abcacf57b75a51dafae777f9dd38bc7053d1af526f220a7489a6d3a2753e5f3e8b1cfe39b56f43611df74a",
        "withdrawal_credentials": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "effective_balance": "1",
        "slashed": false,
        "activation_eligibility_epoch": "1",
        "activation_epoch": "1",
        "exit_epoch": "1",
        "withdrawable_epoch": "1"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid state ID: current"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "State not found"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid state or validator ID, or status|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|State not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|

## Get validator from state by id

<a id="opIdgetStateValidator"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/validators/string \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/validators/{validator_id}`

Returns validator specified by state and id or public key along with status and balance.

<h3 id="get-validator-from-state-by-id-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|

## Get builders from state

<a id="opIdgetStateBuilders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/builders \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "ids": [
      "string"
    ],
    "statuses": [
      "active"
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/builders`

Returns filterable list of builders with their status and index.

Information will be returned for all indices or public keys that match known builders. If an index or public key does not
match any known builder, no information will be returned but this will not cause an error. There are no guarantees for the
returned data in terms of ordering; both the index and public key are returned for each builder, and can be used to confirm
for which inputs a response has been returned.

Returns 400 if the requested state is prior to Gloas.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "ids": [
    "string"
  ],
  "statuses": [
    "active"
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="get-builders-from-state-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state_id|path|string|true|State identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", "justified", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded stateRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|
|body|body|object|false|The lists of builder IDs and statuses to filter on.<br>If no body is supplied then all builders will be returned. To return all active builders, omit `ids` and set `statuses` to `["active"]`.<br>|
|» ids|body|[string]|false|An array of values, with each value either a hex encoded public key (any bytes48 with 0x prefix) or a builder index.<br><br>If the supplied list is empty (i.e. the value is `[]`) or the property is omitted then all builders will be returned.<br>|
|» statuses|body|[[BuilderStatus](#schemabuilderstatus)]|false|An array of builder statuses to filter on.<br><br>If the supplied list is empty (i.e. the value is `[]`) or the property is omitted then builders with all statuses will be returned.<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|» statuses|pending|
|» statuses|active|
|» statuses|exited|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "index": "1",
      "status": "active",
      "builder": {
        "pubkey": "0x93247f2209abcacf57b75a51dafae777f9dd38bc7053d1af526f220a7489a6d3a2753e5f3e8b1cfe39b56f43611df74a",
        "version": "0",
        "execution_address": "0xAbcF8e0d4e9587369b2301D0790347320302cc09",
        "balance": "1",
        "deposit_epoch": "1",
        "withdrawable_epoch": "1"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid state ID: current"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "State not found"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-builders-from-state-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid state ID, builder ID, or malformed request|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|State not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-builders-from-state-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[[BuilderResponse](#schemabuilderresponse)]|true|none|none|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|

## Get the payload timeliness committee for a slot.

<a id="opIdgetStatePtc"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/ptc \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/ptc`

Returns the [payload timeliness committee](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#new-get_ptc) for the requested slot from the state with the given `state_id`.
Should return 400 if the state retrieved or the requested slot is prior to Gloas.


<h3 id="get-the-payload-timeliness-committee-for-a-slot-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state_id|path|string|true|State identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", "justified", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded stateRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|
|slot|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|false|Slot for which to retrieve the committee. Defaults to the state's slot.<br>The slot's epoch must be between `get_current_epoch(state) - 1`<br>(or the genesis epoch in the case of underflow) and<br>`get_current_epoch(state) + MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD`, inclusive.<br>|

## Get the RANDAO mix for some epoch in a specified state.

<a id="opIdgetStateRandao"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/states/head/randao \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/states/{state_id}/randao`

Fetch the RANDAO mix for the requested epoch from the state identified by `state_id`.

If an epoch is not specified then the RANDAO mix for the state's current epoch will be returned.

By adjusting the `state_id` parameter you can query for any historic value of the RANDAO mix.
Ordinarily states from the same epoch will mutate the RANDAO mix for that epoch as blocks are
applied.


<h3 id="get-the-randao-mix-for-some-epoch-in-a-specified-state-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|state_id|path|string|true|State identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", "justified", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded stateRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|
|epoch|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|false|Epoch to fetch the RANDAO mix for. Default: state's current epoch.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": {
    "randao": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Epoch is out of range for the `randao_mixes` of the state"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "State not found"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-the-randao-mix-for-some-epoch-in-a-specified-state-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid state ID or epoch|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|State not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-the-randao-mix-for-some-epoch-in-a-specified-state-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|object|true|none|none|
|» randao|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|RANDAO mix for requested epoch in state.|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h3 id="get-state-builder-pending-payments-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid request syntax.|Inline|
|404|Not Found|Not found|Inline|
|406|Not Acceptable|Accepted media type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-state-builder-pending-payments-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|[ConsensusVersion](#schemaconsensusversion)|true|none|none|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[Gloas.BuilderPendingPayments](#schemagloas.builderpendingpayments)|true|none|Fixed vector of pending builder payments covering two epochs.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|version|phase0|
|version|altair|
|version|bellatrix|
|version|capella|
|version|deneb|
|version|electra|
|version|fulu|
|version|gloas|

Status Code **400**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **404**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **406**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|The media type in "Accept" header is unsupported, and the request has been rejected. This occurs when the server cannot produce a response in the format accepted by the client.|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Version|string||The active consensus version to which the data belongs. Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data<br>more effectively.<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get block headers

<a id="opIdgetBlockHeaders"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/headers \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/headers`

Retrieves block headers matching given query. By default it will fetch current head slot blocks.

<h3 id="get-block-headers-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|false|none|
|parent_root|query|[Root](#schemaroot)|false|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
      "canonical": true,
      "header": {
        "message": {
          "slot": "1",
          "proposer_index": "1",
          "parent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
          "state_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
          "body_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
        },
        "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid slot: current"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-block-headers-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The slot or parent root supplied could not be parsed|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-block-headers-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[object]|true|none|none|
|» root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|none|
|» canonical|boolean|true|none|none|
|» header|[Phase0.SignedBeaconBlockHeader](#schemaphase0.signedbeaconblockheader)|true|none|The [`SignedBeaconBlockHeader`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblockheader) object envelope from the CL spec.|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get block header

<a id="opIdgetBlockHeader"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/headers/head \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/headers/{block_id}`

Retrieves block header for given block id.

<h3 id="get-block-header-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|block_id|path|string|true|Block identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded blockRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": {
    "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
    "canonical": true,
    "header": {
      "message": {
        "slot": "1",
        "proposer_index": "1",
        "parent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "state_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "body_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
      },
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid block ID: current"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "Block not found"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-block-header-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The block ID supplied could not be parsed|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|Block not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-block-header-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|object|true|none|none|

## Publish a signed block.

<a id="opIdpublishBlindedBlockV2"></a>

> Code samples


`POST /eth/v2/beacon/blinded_blocks`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Instructs the beacon node to use the components of the `SignedBlindedBeaconBlock` to construct and publish a 
`SignedBeaconBlock` by swapping out the `transactions_root` for the corresponding full list of `transactions`.
The beacon node should broadcast a newly constructed `SignedBeaconBlock` to the beacon network,
to be included in the beacon chain. The beacon node is not required to validate the signed
`BeaconBlock`, and a successful response (20X) only indicates that the broadcast has been
successful. The beacon node is expected to integrate the new block into its state, and
therefore validate the block internally, however blocks which fail the validation are still
broadcast but a different status code is returned (202). Before Bellatrix, this endpoint will accept 
a `SignedBeaconBlock`. The broadcast behaviour may be adjusted via the `broadcast_validation`
query parameter.

This endpoint only supports forks through Fulu. Gloas blocks do not have a blinded form and
MUST be published through `POST /eth/v2/beacon/blocks`.

<h3 id="publish-a-signed-block-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcast_validation|query|[BroadcastValidation](#schemabroadcastvalidation)|false|Level of validation that must be applied to a block before it is broadcast.<br><br>Possible values:<br>- **`gossip`** (default): lightweight gossip checks only<br>- **`consensus`**: full consensus checks, including validation of all signatures and<br>  blocks fields _except_ for the execution payload transactions.<br>- **`consensus_and_equivocation`**: the same as `consensus`, with an extra equivocation<br>  check immediately before the block is broadcast. If the block is found to be an<br>  equivocation it fails validation.<br><br>If the block fails the requested level of a validation a 400 status MUST be returned<br>immediately and the block MUST NOT be broadcast to the network.<br><br>If validation succeeds, the block must still be fully verified before it is<br>incorporated into the state and a 20x status is returned to the caller.<br>|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|header|string|true|The active consensus version to which the block being submitted belongs.|
|body|body|[Electra.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemaelectra.signedblindedbeaconblock) \| [Deneb.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemadeneb.signedblindedbeaconblock) \| [Capella.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemacapella.signedblindedbeaconblock) \| [Bellatrix.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemabellatrix.signedblindedbeaconblock) \| [Altair.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaaltair.signedbeaconblock) \| [Phase0.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaphase0.signedbeaconblock)|true|The `SignedBlindedBeaconBlock` object composed of `BlindedBeaconBlock` object (produced by beacon node) and validator signature.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Electra.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemaelectra.signedblindedbeaconblock)|false|A variant of the [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.5.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Electra spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlock` rather than a `BeaconBlock`.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Deneb.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemadeneb.signedblindedbeaconblock)|false|A variant of the [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Deneb spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlock` rather than a `BeaconBlock`.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Capella.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemacapella.signedblindedbeaconblock)|false|A variant of the [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Capella spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlock` rather than a `BeaconBlock`.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Bellatrix.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemabellatrix.signedblindedbeaconblock)|false|A variant of the [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Bellatrix spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlock` rather than a `BeaconBlock`.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Altair.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaaltair.signedbeaconblock)|false|The [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Altair spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Phase0.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaphase0.signedbeaconblock)|false|The [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL spec.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|broadcast_validation|gossip|
|broadcast_validation|consensus|
|broadcast_validation|consensus_and_equivocation|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|phase0|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|altair|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|bellatrix|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|capella|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|deneb|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|electra|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|fulu|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid block: missing signature"
}
```

> 415 Response

```json
{
  "code": 415,
  "message": "Cannot read the supplied content type."
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

<h3 id="publish-a-signed-block-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The block was validated successfully and has been broadcast. It has also been integrated into the beacon node's database.|None|
|202|Accepted|The block failed validation, but was successfully broadcast anyway. It was not integrated into the beacon node's database.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The `SignedBlindedBeaconBlock` object is invalid or broadcast validation failed|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Supplied content-type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Beacon node is currently syncing, try again later.|Inline|

<h3 id="publish-a-signed-block-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **415**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|The media type in "Content-Type" header is unsupported, and the request has been rejected. This occurs when a HTTP request supplies a payload in a content-type that the server is not able to handle.|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **503**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

`POST /eth/v2/beacon/blocks`

Instructs the beacon node to broadcast a newly signed beacon block to the beacon network,
to be included in the beacon chain. A success response (20x) indicates that the block
passed gossip validation and was successfully broadcast onto the network.
The beacon node is also expected to integrate the block into the state, but may broadcast it
before doing so, so as to aid timely delivery of the block. Should the block fail full
validation, a separate success response code (202) is used to indicate that the block was
successfully broadcast but failed integration. For Deneb/Electra/Fulu, this additionally instructs
the beacon node to broadcast all given blobs. For Gloas and later, blobs are broadcast as part
of the `ExecutionPayloadEnvelope` and are not submitted with the block. The broadcast behaviour
may be adjusted via the `broadcast_validation` query parameter.

<h3 id="publish-a-signed-block-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcast_validation|query|[BroadcastValidation](#schemabroadcastvalidation)|false|Level of validation that must be applied to a block before it is broadcast.<br><br>Possible values:<br>- **`gossip`** (default): lightweight gossip checks only<br>- **`consensus`**: full consensus checks, including validation of all signatures and<br>  blocks fields _except_ for the execution payload transactions.<br>- **`consensus_and_equivocation`**: the same as `consensus`, with an extra equivocation<br>  check immediately before the block is broadcast. If the block is found to be an<br>  equivocation it fails validation.<br><br>If the block fails the requested level of a validation a 400 status MUST be returned<br>immediately and the block MUST NOT be broadcast to the network.<br><br>If validation succeeds, the block must still be fully verified before it is<br>incorporated into the state and a 20x status is returned to the caller.<br>|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|header|[ConsensusVersion](#schemaconsensusversion)|true|The active consensus version to which the block being submitted belongs.|
|Eth-Builder-Url|header|string(uri)|false|The `url` of the winning builder, as returned by `POST /eth/v4/validator/blocks/{slot}`.<br>When that endpoint returns this header the validator client MUST echo it here, so the beacon<br>node can forward the signed block to the same builder and the builder can release the<br>payload without waiting for gossip. The echo is what lets a beacon node that did not serve<br>the block-production request still forward it. Omitted for a self-built block or a block won<br>by a p2p bid.<br><br>The URL is untrusted input and a server-side request forgery (SSRF) risk: the beacon<br>node issues only the builder-API `submitSignedBeaconBlock` request to it, over http(s),<br>and MUST NOT follow redirects. Deployments serving callers beyond their own validator<br>clients SHOULD also reject URLs that resolve to private address space, since a caller<br>can otherwise use the forwarded request to reach internal endpoints.<br>|
|body|body|[Gloas.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemagloas.signedbeaconblock) \| [Fulu.SignedBlockContents](#schemafulu.signedblockcontents) \| [Electra.SignedBlockContents](#schemaelectra.signedblockcontents) \| [Deneb.SignedBlockContents](#schemadeneb.signedblockcontents) \| [Capella.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemacapella.signedbeaconblock) \| [Bellatrix.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemabellatrix.signedbeaconblock) \| [Altair.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaaltair.signedbeaconblock) \| [Phase0.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaphase0.signedbeaconblock)|true|The `SignedBeaconBlock` object composed of `BeaconBlock` object (produced by beacon node) and validator signature.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Gloas.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemagloas.signedbeaconblock)|false|The [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Gloas spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Fulu.SignedBlockContents](#schemafulu.signedblockcontents)|false|The required signed components of block production according to the Fulu CL spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Electra.SignedBlockContents](#schemaelectra.signedblockcontents)|false|The required signed components of block production according to the Electra CL spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Deneb.SignedBlockContents](#schemadeneb.signedblockcontents)|false|The required signed components of block production according to the Deneb CL spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Capella.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemacapella.signedbeaconblock)|false|The [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Capella spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Bellatrix.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemabellatrix.signedbeaconblock)|false|The [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Bellatrix spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Altair.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaaltair.signedbeaconblock)|false|The [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Altair spec.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Phase0.SignedBeaconBlock](#schemaphase0.signedbeaconblock)|false|The [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL spec.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid block: missing signature"
}
```

> 415 Response

```json
{
  "code": 415,
  "message": "Cannot read the supplied content type."
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

<h3 id="publish-a-signed-block-1-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The block was validated successfully and has been broadcast. It has also been integrated into the beacon node's database.|None|
|202|Accepted|The block could not be integrated into the beacon node's database as it failed validation, but was successfully broadcast.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The `SignedBeaconBlock` object is invalid or broadcast validation failed|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Supplied content-type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Beacon node is currently syncing, try again later.|Inline|

<h3 id="publish-a-signed-block-1-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **415**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|The media type in "Content-Type" header is unsupported, and the request has been rejected. This occurs when a HTTP request supplies a payload in a content-type that the server is not able to handle.|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **503**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Publish signed execution payload bid

<a id="opIdpublishExecutionPayloadBid"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/execution_payload_bids \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/execution_payload_bids`

Instructs the beacon node to broadcast a signed execution payload bid to the network,
to be gossiped for potential inclusion in block building. The beacon node SHOULD run gossip
validation on the bid before broadcasting it, but MAY skip validation for bids submitted by a
locally configured builder to reduce publishing latency. A success response (20x) indicates
that the bid was successfully broadcast onto the network.

|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/execution_payload_envelopes`

Instructs the beacon node to broadcast a signed execution payload envelope to the network,
to be gossiped for payload validation. A success response (20x) indicates
that the envelope passed gossip validation and was successfully broadcast onto the network.
The beacon node is also expected to integrate the envelope into the state, but may broadcast it
before doing so, so as to aid timely delivery of the envelope. Should the envelope fail full
validation, a separate success response code (202) is used to indicate that the envelope was
successfully broadcast but failed integration. The broadcast behaviour may be adjusted via
the `broadcast_validation` query parameter.

The request body can be either form, distinguished by the `Eth-Blob-Data-Included`
header:
- A `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelopeContents` object (header `true`) containing the signed
  envelope along with blobs and KZG proofs. This is used in stateless operation (multi-BN
  setups, distributed validators, failover) where the receiving beacon node does not have
  the blobs cached.
- A `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope` object (header `false`) containing only the signed
  envelope. This is used in stateful operation where the beacon node has the blobs and
  KZG proofs cached from block production and attaches them before broadcasting.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "signed_execution_payload_envelope": {
    "message": {

        "parent_hash": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
```

<h3 id="publish-signed-execution-payload-envelope-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|broadcast_validation|query|[BroadcastValidation](#schemabroadcastvalidation)|false|Level of validation that must be applied to an envelope before it is broadcast.<br><br>Possible values:<br>- **`gossip`** (default): lightweight gossip checks only<br>- **`consensus`**: full consensus checks, including validation of all signatures and<br>  envelope fields.<br>- **`consensus_and_equivocation`**: the same as `consensus`, with an extra check that<br>  the envelope's beacon block is not an equivocation. If the block is found to be an<br>  equivocation, validation fails. This is recommended for builders to protect against<br>  unbundling attacks where a malicious proposer publishes equivocating blocks to extract<br>  payload contents from honest builders.<br><br>If the envelope fails the requested level of validation, a 400 status MUST be returned<br>immediately and the envelope MUST NOT be broadcast to the network.<br><br>If validation succeeds, the envelope must still be fully verified before it is<br>incorporated into the state and a 20x status is returned to the caller.<br>|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|header|[ConsensusVersion](#schemaconsensusversion)|true|The active consensus version to which the execution payload envelope being submitted belongs.|
|Eth-Blob-Data-Included|header|boolean|true|Indicates which body schema is submitted. When `true`, the body is a<br>`SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelopeContents` (signed envelope plus blobs and KZG proofs,<br>stateless flow). When `false`, the body is a `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope`<br>(signed envelope only, stateful flow; the beacon node must have cached the blobs<br>and KZG proofs from block production).<br>|
|body|body|[Gloas.SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelopeContents](#schemagloas.signedexecutionpayloadenvelopecontents) \| [Gloas.SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope](#schemagloas.signedexecutionpayloadenvelope)|true|The `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelopeContents` or `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope` object to be broadcast, selected via the `Eth-Blob-Data-Included` header.|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Gloas.SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelopeContents](#schemagloas.signedexecutionpayloadenvelopecontents)|false|Signed execution payload envelope bundled with blobs and KZG proofs for stateless<br>publishing. Used when the validator client publishes to a beacon node that does not<br>have the blobs cached (e.g. multi-BN setups, distributed validators, failover).<br>|
|» *anyOf*|body|[Gloas.SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope](#schemagloas.signedexecutionpayloadenvelope)|false|The [`SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#signedexecutionpayloadenvelope) object from the CL Gloas spec.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|broadcast_validation|gossip|
|broadcast_validation|consensus|
|broadcast_validation|consensus_and_equivocation|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|phase0|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|altair|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|bellatrix|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|capella|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|deneb|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|electra|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|fulu|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|gloas|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid signed execution payload envelope"
}
```

> 415 Response

```json
{
  "code": 415,
  "message": "Cannot read the supplied content type."
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

<h3 id="publish-signed-execution-payload-envelope-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|The envelope was validated successfully and has been broadcast. It has also been integrated into the beacon node's database.|None|
|202|Accepted|The envelope could not be integrated into the beacon node's database as it failed validation, but was successfully broadcast.|None|
|400|Bad Request|The signed envelope object is invalid, broadcast validation failed, or an envelope<br>without blob data was submitted but the beacon node has no cached blobs and KZG<br>proofs to attach (e.g. because block production happened on a different beacon node).<br>|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|415|Unsupported Media Type|Supplied content-type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Beacon node is currently syncing, try again later.|Inline|

> Code samples


`GET /eth/v1/beacon/execution_payload_envelopes/{block_id}`

Depending on `Accept` header it can be returned either as json or as bytes serialized by SSZ.

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|

|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-signed-execution-payload-envelope-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|string|true|none|none|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[Gloas.SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope](#schemagloas.signedexecutionpayloadenvelope)|true|none|The [`SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#signedexecutionpayloadenvelope) object from the CL Gloas spec.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|version|gloas|

Status Code **406**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|The media type in "Accept" header is unsupported, and the request has been rejected. This occurs when the server cannot produce a response in the format accepted by the client.|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Version|string||The active consensus version to which the data belongs. Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data<br>more effectively.<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get signed proposer preferences

<a id="opIdgetProposerPreferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/proposer_preferences \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/proposer_preferences`

Retrieves signed proposer preferences known by the node for upcoming proposal slots.

Signed proposer preferences are only broadcast once per proposal slot and dependent root.
This allows builders to retrieve the ones that were broadcast before they subscribed to the
`proposer_preferences` event.


<h3 id="get-signed-proposer-preferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|false|Only return signed proposer preferences for this proposal slot.|
|dependent_root|query|[Root](#schemaroot)|false|Only return signed proposer preferences with this dependent root.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "gloas",
  "data": [
    {
      "message": {
        "dependent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "proposal_slot": "1",
        "validator_index": "1",
        "fee_recipient": "0xAbcF8e0d4e9587369b2301D0790347320302cc09",
        "target_gas_limit": "1"
      },
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid slot parameter"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-signed-proposer-preferences-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The slot or dependent root could not be parsed|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-signed-proposer-preferences-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|string|true|none|none|
|data|[[Gloas.SignedProposerPreferences](#schemagloas.signedproposerpreferences)]|true|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|version|gloas|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Version|string||The active consensus version to which the data belongs. Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data<br>more effectively.<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get blobs

<a id="opIdgetBlobs"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/blobs/head \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/blobs/{block_id}`

Retrieves blobs for a given block id.
Depending on `Accept` header it can be returned either as json or as bytes serialized by SSZ.

If the `versioned_hashes` parameter is specified, only the blobs for the specified versioned hashes will be returned. Blobs are 
returned as an ordered list matching the order of their corresponding KZG commitments in the block.

After the Fulu fork, only supernodes (which custody all data columns) are required to return blobs. Clients may implement
blob reconstruction logic for non-super nodes.


<h3 id="get-blobs-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|block_id|path|string|true|Block identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded blockRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|
|versioned_hashes|query|[[VersionedHash](#schemaversionedhash)]|false|Array of versioned hashes for blobs to request for in the specified block. Returns all blobs in the block if not specified.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid block ID: current"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "Block not found"
}
```

> 406 Response

```json
{
  "code": 406,
  "message": "Accepted media type not supported"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

|---|---|---|---|

|406|Not Acceptable|Accepted media type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[Blobs](#schemablobs)|true|none|none|

|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|

## Get sync committee rewards

```bash
  -d '[
    "string"
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/rewards/sync_committee/{block_id}`

|body|body|[string]|false|An array of either hex encoded public key (any bytes48 with 0x prefix) or validator index|

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
```

## Get block rewards

<a id="opIdgetBlockRewards"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/rewards/blocks/head \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/rewards/blocks/{block_id}`

Retrieve block reward info for a single block. The rewards value is the sum
of values of the proposer rewards from attestations, sync committees and
slashings included in the proposal.


<h3 id="get-block-rewards-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|block_id|path|string|true|Block identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded blockRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": {
    "proposer_index": "123",
    "total": "123",
    "attestations": "123",
    "sync_aggregate": "123",
    "proposer_slashings": "123",
    "attester_slashings": "123"
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid request to retrieve block rewards info"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "Block or required state not found"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-block-rewards-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid get block rewards request|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|Block or required state not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-block-rewards-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[BlockRewards](#schemablockrewards)|true|none|Rewards info for a single block|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get attestations rewards

<a id="opIdgetAttestationsRewards"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/rewards/attestations/1 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    "string"
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/rewards/attestations/{epoch}`

Retrieve attestation reward info for validators specified by array of public keys or validator index. If no array is provided, return reward info for every validator.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  "string"
]
```

<h3 id="get-attestations-rewards-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|epoch|path|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|The epoch to get rewards info from|
|body|body|[string]|false|An array of either hex encoded public key (any bytes48 with 0x prefix) or validator index|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": {
    "ideal_rewards": [
      {
        "effective_balance": "1000000000",
        "head": "2500",
        "target": "5000",
        "source": "5000",
        "inclusion_delay": "5000",
        "inactivity": "5000"
      }

    "total_rewards": [
      {
        "validator_index": "0",
        "head": "2000",
        "target": "2000",
        "source": "4000",
        "inclusion_delay": "2000",
        "inactivity": "2000"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid request to retrieve attestations rewards info"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json

  "code": 404,
  "message": "Epoch not known or required data not available"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-attestations-rewards-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid get attestations rewards request|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|Epoch not known or required data not available|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-attestations-rewards-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[AttestationsRewards](#schemaattestationsrewards)|true|none|Rewards info for attestations|

Status Code **500**

## Get blinded block

<a id="opIdgetBlindedBlock"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/blinded_blocks/head \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/blinded_blocks/{block_id}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Retrieves blinded block for given block ID.
Depending on `Accept` header it can be returned either as JSON or as bytes serialized by SSZ.

This endpoint only supports forks through Fulu. Gloas blocks do not have a blinded form.
Use `GET /eth/v2/beacon/blocks/{block_id}` instead.


<h3 id="get-blinded-block-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|block_id|path|string|true|Block identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded blockRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|string|true|none|none|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|

|» *anyOf*|[Electra.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemaelectra.signedblindedbeaconblock)|false|none|A variant of the [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.5.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Electra spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlock` rather than a `BeaconBlock`.|
|» *anyOf*|[Deneb.SignedBlindedBeaconBlock](#schemadeneb.signedblindedbeaconblock)|false|none|A variant of the [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Deneb spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlock` rather than a `BeaconBlock`.|

Status Code **406**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Version|string||The active consensus version to which the data belongs. Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data<br>more effectively.<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get `LightClientBootstrap` structure for a requested block root

<a id="opIdgetLightClientBootstrap"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/light_client/bootstrap/0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/light_client/bootstrap/{block_root}`

Requests the [`LightClientBootstrap`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/sync-protocol.md#lightclientbootstrap) structure corresponding to a given post-Altair beacon block root.
Depending on the `Accept` header it can be returned either as JSON or SSZ-serialized bytes.

Servers SHOULD provide results as defined in [`create_light_client_bootstrap`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/full-node.md#create_light_client_bootstrap). To fulfill a request, the requested block's post state needs to be known.


<h3 id="get-lightclientbootstrap-structure-for-a-requested-block-root-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|block_root|path|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|Block root.<br>\<hex encoded blockRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|

## Get `LightClientUpdate` instances in a requested sync committee period range

<a id="opIdgetLightClientUpdatesByRange"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/light_client/updates?start_period=1&count=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/light_client/updates`

Requests the [`LightClientUpdate`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/sync-protocol.md#lightclientupdate) instances in the sync committee period range `[start_period, start_period + count)`, leading up to the current head sync committee period as selected by fork choice.
Depending on the `Accept` header they can be returned either as JSON or SSZ-serialized bytes.

Servers SHOULD provide results as defined in [`create_light_client_update`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/full-node.md#create_light_client_update). They MUST respond with at least the earliest known result within the requested range, and MUST send results in consecutive order (by period). The response MUST NOT contain more than [`min(MAX_REQUEST_LIGHT_CLIENT_UPDATES, count)`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/p2p-interface.md#configuration) results.


<h3 id="get-lightclientupdate-instances-in-a-requested-sync-committee-period-range-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|start_period|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|
|count|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|

## Get the latest known `LightClientFinalityUpdate`

<a id="opIdgetLightClientFinalityUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/light_client/finality_update \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/light_client/finality_update`

Requests the latest [`LightClientFinalityUpdate`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/sync-protocol.md#lightclientfinalityupdate) known by the server.
Depending on the `Accept` header it can be returned either as JSON or SSZ-serialized bytes.

Servers SHOULD provide results as defined in [`create_light_client_finality_update`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/full-node.md#create_light_client_finality_update).

## Get the latest known `LightClientOptimisticUpdate`

<a id="opIdgetLightClientOptimisticUpdate"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/light_client/optimistic_update \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/beacon/light_client/optimistic_update`

Requests the latest [`LightClientOptimisticUpdate`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/sync-protocol.md#lightclientoptimisticupdate) known by the server.

Servers SHOULD provide results as defined in [`create_light_client_optimistic_update`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/light-client/full-node.md#create_light_client_optimistic_update).
