## Submit Attestation objects to node

<a id="opIdsubmitPoolAttestationsV2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v2/beacon/pool/attestations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Eth-Consensus-Version: gloas' \
  -d '[
    {
      "committee_index": "1",
      "attester_index": "1",
      "data": {
        "slot": "1",
        "index": "0",
        "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "source": {
          "epoch": "1",
          "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
        },
        "target": {
          "epoch": "1",
          "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
        }
      },
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v2/beacon/pool/attestations`

Submits attestations to the node. Each attestation in the request body is processed individually.

If an attestation is validated successfully, the node MUST publish that attestation on the appropriate subnet.

If one or more attestations fail validation, the node MUST return a 400 error with details of which attestations have failed, and why.

Prior to the Electra hard fork, this endpoint MUST be sent Attestation objects only.  At and after the Electra hard fork, this endpoint MUST be sent SingleAttestation objects only.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "committee_index": "1",
    "attester_index": "1",
    "data": {
      "slot": "1",
      "index": "0",
      "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
      "source": {
        "epoch": "1",
        "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
      },
      "target": {
        "epoch": "1",
        "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
      }
    },
    "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="submit-attestation-objects-to-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|header|[ConsensusVersion](#schemaconsensusversion)|true|The consensus version to which the attestations being submitted belong.|
|body|body|[[Electra.SingleAttestation](#schemaelectra.singleattestation)] \| [[Phase0.Attestation](#schemaphase0.attestation)]|true|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[[Electra.SingleAttestation](#schemaelectra.singleattestation)]|false|none|
|» *oneOf*|body|[[Phase0.Attestation](#schemaphase0.attestation)]|false|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|phase0|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|altair|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|bellatrix|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|capella|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|deneb|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|electra|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|fulu|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|gloas|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "some failures",
  "failures": [
    {
      "index": 3,
      "message": "invalid signature"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 415 Response

```json
{
  "code": 415,
  "message": "Cannot read the supplied content type."
}
```

```json
}
```

|415|Unsupported Media Type|Supplied content-type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

## Submit payload attestation messages

<a id="opIdsubmitPayloadAttestationMessages"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/pool/payload_attestations \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Eth-Consensus-Version: gloas' \
  -d '[
    {
      "validator_index": "1",
      "data": {
        "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "slot": "1",
        "payload_present": true,
        "blob_data_available": true
      },
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/pool/payload_attestations`

Submits payload attestation messages to the beacon node.

The beacon node will validate each payload attestation message according to the gossip validation rules
and, if valid, store it in the pool and broadcast it globally to the network.

A success response indicates that the payload attestation message passed validation and was
successfully stored and broadcast.

If one or more payload attestation messages fail validation, the node MUST return a 400 error with details of which messages have failed, and why.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "validator_index": "1",
    "data": {
      "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
      "slot": "1",
      "payload_present": true,
      "blob_data_available": true
    },
    "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  }
]
```

|body|body|[[Gloas.PayloadAttestationMessage](#schemagloas.payloadattestationmessage)]|true|Array of `PayloadAttestationMessage` objects to be submitted.|

## Submit sync committee signatures to node

<a id="opIdsubmitPoolSyncCommitteeSignatures"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/pool/sync_committees \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    {
      "slot": "1",
      "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
      "validator_index": "1",
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/pool/sync_committees`

Submits sync committee signature objects to the node.

Sync committee signatures are not present in phase0, but are required for Altair networks.

If a sync committee signature is validated successfully the node MUST publish that sync committee signature on all applicable subnets.

If one or more sync committee signatures fail validation the node MUST return a 400 error with details of which sync committee signatures have failed, and why.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "slot": "1",
    "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
    "validator_index": "1",
    "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="submit-sync-committee-signatures-to-node-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[[Altair.SyncCommitteeSignature](#schemaaltair.synccommitteesignature)]|true|none|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "some failures",
  "failures": [
    {
      "index": 3,
      "message": "invalid signature"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="submit-sync-committee-signatures-to-node-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Sync committee signatures are stored in pool and broadcast on appropriate subnet|None|
|400|Bad Request|Errors with one or more sync committee signatures|[IndexedErrorMessage](#schemaindexederrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="submit-sync-committee-signatures-to-node-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

</aside>

## Submit SignedVoluntaryExit object to node's pool

<a id="opIdsubmitPoolVoluntaryExit"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/beacon/pool/voluntary_exits \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '{
    "message": {
      "epoch": "1",
      "validator_index": "1"
    },
    "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  }'
```

`POST /eth/v1/beacon/pool/voluntary_exits`

Submits SignedVoluntaryExit object to node's pool and if passes validation node MUST broadcast it to network.

> Body parameter

```json
{
  "message": {
    "epoch": "1",
    "validator_index": "1"
  },
  "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
}
```

<h3 id="submit-signedvoluntaryexit-object-to-nodes-pool-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[Phase0.SignedVoluntaryExit](#schemaphase0.signedvoluntaryexit)|true|none|
|» message|body|object|true|The [`VoluntaryExit`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#voluntaryexit) object from the CL spec.|
|» » epoch|body|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|Minimum epoch for processing exit.|
|» » validator_index|body|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|Index of the exiting validator.|
|» signature|body|[Signature](#schemasignature)|true|none|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid voluntary exit, it will never pass validation so it's rejected"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="submit-signedvoluntaryexit-object-to-nodes-pool-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Voluntary exit is stored in node and broadcasted to network|None|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid voluntary exit|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="submit-signedvoluntaryexit-object-to-nodes-pool-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get spec params.

<a id="opIdgetSpec"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/config/spec \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/config/spec`

Retrieve specification configuration used on this node.  The configuration should include:
  - Constants for all hard forks known by the beacon node, for example the [phase 0](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#constants) and [altair](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/altair/beacon-chain.md#constants) values
  - Presets for all hard forks supplied to the beacon node, for example the [phase 0](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/presets/mainnet/phase0.yaml) and [altair](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/presets/mainnet/altair.yaml) values
  - Configuration for the beacon node, for example the [mainnet](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/configs/mainnet.yaml) values

Values are returned with following format:
  - any value starting with 0x in the spec is returned as a hex string
  - numeric values are returned as a quoted integer
  - array values are returned as a JSON array


> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "DEPOSIT_CONTRACT_ADDRESS": "0x00000000219ab540356cBB839Cbe05303d7705Fa",
    "DEPOSIT_NETWORK_ID": "1",
    "DOMAIN_AGGREGATE_AND_PROOF": "0x06000000",
    "INACTIVITY_PENALTY_QUOTIENT": "67108864",
    "INACTIVITY_PENALTY_QUOTIENT_ALTAIR": "50331648",
    "BLOB_SCHEDULE": [
      {
        "EPOCH": "269568",
        "MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK": "6"
      },
      {
        "EPOCH": "364032",
        "MAX_BLOBS_PER_BLOCK": "9"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-spec-params-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-spec-params-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|object|true|none|Key value mapping of all constants, presets and configuration values for all known hard forks<br>Values are returned with following format:<br>  - any value starting with 0x in the spec is returned as a hex string<br>  - numeric values are returned as a quoted integer<br>|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

<h1 id="eth-beacon-node-api-debug">Debug</h1>

Set of endpoints to debug chain and shouldn't be exposed publicly.

## Get data column sidecars

<a id="opIdgetDebugDataColumnSidecars"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/debug/beacon/data_column_sidecars/head \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/debug/beacon/data_column_sidecars/{block_id}`

Retrieves data column sidecars for a given block id.
Depending on `Accept` header it can be returned either as json or as bytes serialized by SSZ.

If the `indices` parameter is specified, only the data column sidecars with the specified indices will be returned. There are no guarantees
for the returned data column sidecars in terms of ordering.


<h3 id="get-data-column-sidecars-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|block_id|path|string|true|Block identifier.<br>Can be one of: "head" (canonical head in node's view), "genesis", "finalized", \<slot\>, \<hex encoded blockRoot with 0x prefix\>.<br>|
|indices|query|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|false|Array of indices for data column sidecars to request for in the specified block. This endpoint will only return columns that the node is actually custodying. If not specified, returns all data column sidecars that this node is custodying in the block.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "gloas",
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "finalized": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "index": "1",
      "column": [
        "string"
      ],
      "kzg_proofs": [
        {}
      ],
      "slot": "1",
      "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid block ID: current"
}
```

> 404 Response

```json
{
  "code": 404,
  "message": "Block not found"
}
```

> 406 Response

```json
{
  "code": 406,
  "message": "Accepted media type not supported"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h3 id="get-data-column-sidecars-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Successful response|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|The block ID supplied could not be parsed|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|404|Not Found|Block not found|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|406|Not Acceptable|Accepted media type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-data-column-sidecars-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|version|string|true|none|none|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|finalized|[Finalized](#schemafinalized)|true|none|True if the response references the finalized history of the chain, as determined by fork choice. If the field is not present, additional calls are necessary to compare the epoch of the requested information with the finalized checkpoint.|
|data|[Gloas.DataColumnSidecars](#schemagloas.datacolumnsidecars) \| [Fulu.DataColumnSidecars](#schemafulu.datacolumnsidecars)|true|none|none|
|» *anyOf*|[Gloas.DataColumnSidecars](#schemagloas.datacolumnsidecars)|false|none|none|
|» *anyOf*|[Fulu.DataColumnSidecars](#schemafulu.datacolumnsidecars)|false|none|none|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|version|fulu|
|version|gloas|

Status Code **406**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|The media type in "Accept" header is unsupported, and the request has been rejected. This occurs when the server cannot produce a response in the format accepted by the client.|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

Status Code **500**

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|number|true|none|Either specific error code in case of invalid request or http status code|
|message|string|true|none|Message describing error|
|stacktraces|[string]|false|none|Optional stacktraces, sent when node is in debug mode|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Version|string||The active consensus version to which the data belongs. Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data<br>more effectively.<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Get fork choice array

<a id="opIdgetDebugForkChoiceV2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v2/debug/fork_choice \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v2/debug/fork_choice`

Retrieves all current fork choice context, with one node per `(block_root, payload_status)` pair.
Parent links follow the [fork choice tree](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/fork-choice.md#modified-get_node_children).
Each pre-Gloas block has a single `full` node.

Payload Timeliness Committee (PTC) counts are per committee position, including repeated validator
indices, and are the same for all nodes of a block. They are zero for pre-Gloas blocks.


> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "justified_checkpoint": {
      "epoch": "1",
      "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
    },
    "finalized_checkpoint": {
      "epoch": "1",
      "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
    },
    "fork_choice_nodes": [
      {
        "slot": "1",
        "block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "payload_status": "pending",
        "parent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "parent_payload_status": "pending",
        "justified_checkpoint": {
          "epoch": "1",
          "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
        },
        "finalized_checkpoint": {
          "epoch": "1",
          "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
        },
        "weight": "1",
        "validity": "valid",
        "execution_block_hash": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",

        "payload_availability_yes_count": "1",
        "payload_data_availability_yes_count": "1",

      }

}
```

<h1 id="eth-beacon-node-api-events">Events</h1>

Set of endpoints for event subscription.

## Subscribe to beacon node events

<a id="opIdeventstream"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/events?topics=head' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/events`

Provides endpoint to subscribe to beacon node Server-Sent-Events stream.
Consumers should use [eventsource](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html#the-eventsource-interface)
implementation to listen on those events.

Servers _may_ send SSE comments beginning with `:` for any purpose, including to keep the
event stream connection alive in the presence of proxy servers.


<h3 id="subscribe-to-beacon-node-events-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|topics|query|[string]|true|Event types to subscribe to|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|topics|head|
|topics|head_v2|
|topics|block|
|topics|block_gossip|
|topics|attestation|
|topics|single_attestation|
|topics|voluntary_exit|
|topics|bls_to_execution_change|
|topics|proposer_slashing|
|topics|attester_slashing|
|topics|finalized_checkpoint|
|topics|chain_reorg|
|topics|contribution_and_proof|
|topics|light_client_finality_update|
|topics|light_client_optimistic_update|
|topics|payload_attributes|
|topics|data_column_sidecar|
|topics|execution_payload|
|topics|execution_payload_gossip|
|topics|execution_payload_available|
|topics|execution_payload_bid|
|topics|payload_attestation_message|
|topics|fast_confirmation|
|topics|proposer_preferences|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```text
event: head
data: {"slot":"10", "block":"0x9a2fefd2fdb57f74993c7780ea5b9030d2897b615b89f808011ca5aebed54eaf", "state":"0x600e852a08c1200654ddf11025f1ceacb3c2e74bdd5c630cde0838b2591b69f9", "epoch_transition":false, "previous_duty_dependent_root":"0x5e0043f107cb57913498fbf2f99ff55e730bf1e151f02f221e977c91a90a0e91", "current_duty_dependent_root":"0x5e0043f107cb57913498fbf2f99ff55e730bf1e151f02f221e977c91a90a0e91", "execution_optimistic": false}

```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid topic: weather_forecast"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

## Get PTC duties

<a id="opIdgetPtcDuties"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/duties/ptc/1 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    "1"
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/duties/ptc/{epoch}`

Requests the beacon node to provide a set of Payload Timeliness Committee (PTC) duties, which should be performed by validators, for a particular epoch.
Duties should only need to be checked once per epoch, however a chain reorganization (of > MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD epochs) could occur, resulting in a change of duties. For full safety, you should monitor head_v2 events and confirm the dependent root in this response matches:
- event.current_epoch_dependent_root when `compute_epoch_at_slot(event.slot) == epoch`
- event.next_epoch_dependent_root when `compute_epoch_at_slot(event.slot) + 1 == epoch`

The dependent_root value is `get_block_root_at_slot(state, compute_start_slot_at_epoch(epoch - 1) - 1)` or the genesis block root in the case of underflow.

The PTC of `GLOAS_FORK_EPOCH` is computed at the fork from effective balances that are updated at the end of the previous epoch, so its duties can change until the last slot before the fork. For `epoch == GLOAS_FORK_EPOCH`, the dependent_root value is `get_block_root_at_slot(state, compute_start_slot_at_epoch(epoch) - 1)` or the genesis block root in the case of underflow, and matches event.next_epoch_dependent_root when `compute_epoch_at_slot(event.slot) == epoch`. Duties for this epoch are not available before the fork.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  "1"
]
```

<h3 id="get-ptc-duties-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|epoch|path|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|Epoch for which to obtain PTC duties. Must not be greater than the next epoch|
|body|body|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|An array of the validator indices for which to obtain the duties.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "dependent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "pubkey": "0x93247f2209abcacf57b75a51dafae777f9dd38bc7053d1af526f220a7489a6d3a2753e5f3e8b1cfe39b56f43611df74a",
      "validator_index": "1",
      "slot": "1"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid epoch: -2"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

<h3 id="get-ptc-duties-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success response|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid epoch or index|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Beacon node is currently syncing, try again later.|Inline|

<h3 id="get-ptc-duties-responseschema">Response Schema</h3>

Status Code **200**

|dependent_root|[DependentRoot](#schemadependentroot)|true|none|The block root that this response is dependent on.|
|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|data|[[PtcDuty](#schemaptcduty)]|true|none|none|

## Produce a new block, without signature.

<a id="opIdproduceBlockV4"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v4/validator/blocks/1?randao_reveal=0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505&include_payload=true' \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Eth-Consensus-Version: gloas' \
  -d '{
    "min_bid": {},
    "builder_boost_factor": {},
    "builders": [
      {
        "url": "https://builder.example.com",
        "auth": {
          "message": {
            "data": "0x1234567890abcdef",
            "slot": {}
          },
          "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
        },
        "builder_pubkeys": [
          {}
        ],
        "max_execution_payment": {},
        "min_bid": {},
        "builder_boost_factor": {}
      }
    ]
  }'
```

`POST /eth/v4/validator/blocks/{slot}`

Requests a beacon node to produce a valid block, which the validator then signs.

The beacon node always builds a local payload and MAY consider a p2p bid, so a block is returned
even when no builder bid is available. The validator client supplies a `BuilderConfig` in the
request body: a list of `BuilderEntry` objects in its `builders` field, one per bid request,
plus a top-level `min_bid` and `builder_boost_factor` that apply to p2p bids. Each entry
requests a bid from its `url`, and the entry applies to the bid that request returns; an empty
`builder_pubkeys` list accepts any builder, and a bid MUST NOT be accepted unless signed by
one of a non-empty list.

A bid's total payment counts its `execution_payment` at most at the `max_execution_payment`
that applies to it; payment above that cap adds nothing to the bid's chances, though the
proposer still receives it if the builder honors the bid. A builder bid, over the builder API
or p2p, is rejected if its total payment falls below the `min_bid` that applies to it. Every
surviving bid is then weighted by the `builder_boost_factor` that applies to it, and the
highest weighted value competes with the local build's value weighted by `100`. The local
build wins a tie.

The response carries the full block contents only when the beacon node self-built the block and
`include_payload` is `true`; in every other case, including any builder bid win, it carries
only the `BeaconBlock`.

Every block is published via `POST /eth/v2/beacon/blocks`. A self-built block carries
`BUILDER_INDEX_SELF_BUILD` as its `builder_index`, and the validator client publishes its
execution payload envelope via `POST /eth/v1/beacon/execution_payload_envelopes`. When a
builder bid won, the winning builder releases the envelope instead, and the validator client
echoes `Eth-Builder-Url` if one was returned.

This endpoint is specific to the post-Gloas forks and is not backwards compatible with previous
forks.


> Body parameter

```json
{
  "min_bid": {},
  "builder_boost_factor": {},
  "builders": [
    {
      "url": "https://builder.example.com",
      "auth": {
        "message": {
          "data": "0x1234567890abcdef",
          "slot": {}
        },
        "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
      },
      "builder_pubkeys": [
        {}
      ],
      "max_execution_payment": {},
      "min_bid": {},
      "builder_boost_factor": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

<h3 id="produce-a-new-block-without-signature-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|path|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|The slot for which the block should be proposed.|
|randao_reveal|query|[Signature](#schemasignature)|true|The validator's randao reveal value.|
|graffiti|query|[Graffiti](#schemagraffiti)|false|Arbitrary data validator wants to include in block.|
|skip_randao_verification|query|string|false|Skip verification of the `randao_reveal` value. If this flag is set then the<br>`randao_reveal` must be set to the point at infinity (`0xc0..00`). <br>|
|include_payload|query|boolean|true|Controls whether the execution payload envelope and blobs are included in the response<br>when self-building (using local execution payload).<br><br>When `true`, the response includes the full block contents: beacon block,<br>execution payload envelope, blobs, and KZG proofs. This enables stateless operation<br>where the validator client can use multiple beacon nodes (multi-BN setups, distributed validators, failover).<br><br>When `false`, only the beacon block is returned and the beacon node caches the execution<br>payload envelope and blobs internally. The validator client must then fetch them separately<br>via `GET /eth/v1/validator/execution_payload_envelopes/{slot}/{beacon_block_root}`. This saves<br>bandwidth but requires the validator client to publish via the same beacon node that<br>produced the block (stateful operation).<br><br>This parameter affects the self-built case only. When a builder bid wins, the beacon node<br>does not hold that payload, so it returns only the beacon block regardless of this<br>parameter.<br>|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|header|[ConsensusVersion](#schemaconsensusversion)|true|The active consensus version to which the request belongs.|
|body|body|[Gloas.BuilderConfig](#schemagloas.builderconfig)|true|A `BuilderConfig` for this request: the builder entries to solicit bids from, plus the<br>top-level `min_bid` and `builder_boost_factor` that apply to p2p bids.<br>Each entry's `auth.message.slot` is the `slot` this request is for;<br>the builder rejects a mismatch, so an entry naming a different slot is one the beacon node<br>does not use for a bid request. A missing body, or one that cannot be decoded, is invalid and<br>MUST fail with a 400. Every other failure is per entry: an entry the beacon node rejects, or<br>whose builder does not answer, yields no bid and MUST NOT fail the request, so one bad entry<br>never costs the proposer its slot. A local-preferred build is requested with an empty<br>`builders` list and a `builder_boost_factor` of `0`, which prefers the local payload unless<br>an error makes it unviable.<br>|
|» min_bid|body|object|true|none|
|» builder_boost_factor|body|object|true|none|
|» builders|body|[[Gloas.BuilderEntry](#schemagloas.builderentry)]|true|The builders to request bids from, one `BuilderEntry` each. Empty means request none, so only p2p bids are considered.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|phase0|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|altair|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|bellatrix|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|capella|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|deneb|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|electra|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|fulu|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|gloas|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "gloas",
  "consensus_block_value": "12345",
  "execution_payload_value": "12345",
  "execution_payload_included": false,
  "data": {
    "slot": "1",
    "proposer_index": "1",
    "parent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
    "state_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
    "body": {
      "randao_reveal": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505",
      "eth1_data": {
        "deposit_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "deposit_count": "1",
        "block_hash": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
      },
      "graffiti": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
      "proposer_slashings": [
        {
          "signed_header_1": {
            "message": {
              "slot": "1",
              "proposer_index": "1",
              "parent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
              "state_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
              "body_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
            },
            "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
          },
          "signed_header_2": {
            "message": {
              "slot": "1",
              "proposer_index": "1",
              "parent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
```

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|consensus_block_value|string|true|none|Consensus rewards for this block in Wei|
|execution_payload_value|string|true|none|Execution payload value in Wei. The value of the local execution payload when<br>self-building, or the total value of the builder bid when committing to one.<br>|
|execution_payload_included|boolean|true|none|Indicates whether the execution payload envelope is included in the response.<br>When `true`, the `data` field contains a `BlockContents` object with the<br>beacon block, execution payload envelope, KZG proofs, and blobs. When `false`,<br>the `data` field contains only a `BeaconBlock`.<br>|
|data|[Gloas.BeaconBlock](#schemagloas.beaconblock) \| [Gloas.BlockContents](#schemagloas.blockcontents)|true|none|none|
|» *anyOf*|[Gloas.BeaconBlock](#schemagloas.beaconblock)|false|none|The [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Gloas spec.|
|» *anyOf*|[Gloas.BlockContents](#schemagloas.blockcontents)|false|none|Block contents for self-building, including the execution payload envelope<br>and blobs. This enables stateless failover to another beacon node for publishing,<br>as all required data is returned in a single response.<br>|

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Version|string||The active consensus version to which the data belongs. Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data<br>more effectively.<br>|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Block-Value|string||Consensus rewards for this block in Wei paid to the proposer. The<br>rewards value is the sum of values of the proposer rewards from<br>attestations, sync committees and slashings included in the proposal.<br>Required in response so client can determine relative value of<br>consensus blocks.<br>|
|200|Eth-Execution-Payload-Value|string||Execution payload value in Wei. Required in response so client can determine relative value<br>of execution payloads.<br>|
|200|Eth-Execution-Payload-Included|boolean||Indicates whether the execution payload envelope, blobs, and KZG proofs are included in the response. Required in response so client can deserialize returned data.<br>|
|200|Eth-Builder-Url|string|uri|The `url` of a winning builder when the bid was retrieved via the builder-API.<br>The validator client MUST echo this value in the `Eth-Builder-Url` request header when<br>publishing the signed block, so the beacon node can forward the block to the same builder<br>via `submitSignedBeaconBlock`. Absent for a self-built block or a bid won over p2p.<br>|

## Determine if a distributed validator has been selected to aggregate attestations

<a id="opIdsubmitBeaconCommitteeSelections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/beacon_committee_selections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    {
      "validator_index": "1",
      "slot": "1",
      "selection_proof": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/beacon_committee_selections`

This endpoint should be used by a validator client running as part of a distributed validator cluster, and is 
implemented by a distributed validator middleware client. This endpoint is used to exchange partial 
selection proofs for combined/aggregated selection proofs to allow a validator client 
to correctly determine if any of its validators has been selected to perform an attestation aggregation duty in a slot. 
Validator clients running in a distributed validator cluster must query this endpoint at the start of an epoch either for all slots of 
the current epoch or for all slots of the current and all slots of the next epoch in two separate requests. In both cases it should be for 
all validators that have attester duties in the respective epoch. Consensus clients need not support this endpoint and may return a 501.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "validator_index": "1",
    "slot": "1",
    "selection_proof": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="determine-if-a-distributed-validator-has-been-selected-to-aggregate-attestations-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[[BeaconCommitteeSelection](#schemabeaconcommitteeselection)]|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "validator_index": "1",
      "slot": "1",
      "selection_proof": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "string",
  "stacktraces": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 501 Response

```json
{
  "code": 501,
  "message": "Endpoint not implemented"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

## Determine if a distributed validator has been selected to make a sync committee contribution

<a id="opIdsubmitSyncCommitteeSelections"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/sync_committee_selections \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    {
      "validator_index": "1",
      "slot": "1",
      "subcommittee_index": "1",
      "selection_proof": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/sync_committee_selections`

Submit sync committee selections to a DVT middleware client. It returns the threshold aggregated sync 
committee selection. This endpoint should be used by a validator client running as part of a distributed 
validator cluster, and is implemented by a distributed validator middleware client. This endpoint is 
used to exchange partial selection proofs (slot signatures) for combined/aggregated selection proofs to 
allow a validator client to correctly determine if any of its validators has been selected to perform a 
sync committee contribution (sync aggregation) duty in a slot. Validator clients running in a distributed validator cluster must query this endpoint
at the start of each slot for all validators that are included in the current sync committee. Consensus
clients need not support this endpoint and may return a 501.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "validator_index": "1",
    "slot": "1",
    "subcommittee_index": "1",
    "selection_proof": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="determine-if-a-distributed-validator-has-been-selected-to-make-a-sync-committee-contribution-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[[SyncCommitteeSelection](#schemasynccommitteeselection)]|true|none|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "validator_index": "1",
      "slot": "1",
      "subcommittee_index": "1",
      "selection_proof": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "string",
  "stacktraces": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```bash
      },
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }

```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/register_validator`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Deprecated from Gloas onwards. Under Gloas, proposer fee recipient and gas limit preferences
are expressed via `POST /eth/v1/validator/proposer_preferences` instead. Beacon node support
for this endpoint pre-Gloas is REQUIRED; post-Gloas support is OPTIONAL and the endpoint
MAY be removed.

Prepares the beacon node for engaging with external builders. The
information must be sent by the beacon node to the builder network. It is
expected that the validator client will send this information periodically
to ensure the beacon node has correct and timely registration information
to provide to builders.

Note that only registrations for active or pending validators must be sent to the builder network.
Registrations for unknown or exited validators must be filtered out and not sent to the builder network.

```json
]
```

## Submit signed proposer preferences

<a id="opIdsubmitProposerPreferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/proposer_preferences \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Eth-Consensus-Version: gloas' \
  -d '[
    {
      "message": {
        "dependent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
        "proposal_slot": "1",
        "validator_index": "1",
        "fee_recipient": "0xAbcF8e0d4e9587369b2301D0790347320302cc09",
        "target_gas_limit": "1"
      },
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/proposer_preferences`

Verifies given signed proposer preferences and publishes them on the `proposer_preferences`
gossipsub topic.

Notes:
- Validator clients SHOULD begin submitting signed proposer preferences one epoch before the
  Gloas fork activates, so the proposer preference caches kept by both beacon nodes and
  builders are warm at the fork boundary, letting builders prepare valid bids for the first
  Gloas slots.
- Until the Gloas fork activates, beacon nodes MUST continue to honor fee recipient and gas
  limit information supplied via `POST /eth/v1/validator/prepare_beacon_proposer` and
  `POST /eth/v1/validator/register_validator`. From the Gloas fork onwards, signed proposer
  preferences supersede both endpoints as the source of proposer fee recipient and gas
  limit preferences.
- For validators served by the beacon node, if no signed proposer preferences are available
  for a given proposal slot, the beacon node SHOULD fall back to the parent block's gas limit
  when preparing the local payload or accepting bids for that validator. On the p2p network,
  bids whose fee recipient or gas limit do not match a validator's preferences are rejected at
  gossip validation, while bids for a slot with no available preferences are ignored; applying
  sensible defaults reduces missed proposals during the transition.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "message": {
      "dependent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
      "proposal_slot": "1",
      "validator_index": "1",
      "fee_recipient": "0xAbcF8e0d4e9587369b2301D0790347320302cc09",
      "target_gas_limit": "1"
    },
    "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="submit-signed-proposer-preferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|header|[ConsensusVersion](#schemaconsensusversion)|true|The active consensus version to which the signed proposer preferences being submitted belongs.|
|body|body|[[Gloas.SignedProposerPreferences](#schemagloas.signedproposerpreferences)]|true|Array of `SignedProposerPreferences` objects to be submitted.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|phase0|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|altair|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|bellatrix|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|capella|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|deneb|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|electra|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|fulu|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|gloas|

```json
  "code": 400,
  "message": "some failures",
  "failures": [
    {
      "index": 3,
      "message": "invalid signature"
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
}
```

## Submit builder preferences

<a id="opIdsubmitBuilderPreferences"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/builder_preferences \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'Eth-Consensus-Version: gloas' \
  -d '[
    {
      "proposer_pubkey": {},
      "url": "https://builder.example.com",
      "auth": {
        "message": {
          "data": "0x1234567890abcdef",
          "slot": {}
        },
        "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
      },
      "max_execution_payment": {}
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/builder_preferences`

Submits per-builder preferences for one or more proposers. The request body is a flat list of
`BuilderPreferencesEntry` objects, each naming the proposer in `proposer_pubkey`; the beacon
node submits each to the builder-API `submitBuilderPreferences` endpoint at the entry's `url`.
Applicable from the Gloas fork onwards.

Notes:
- Each entry targets one builder `url`, to which the beacon node makes one submission.
- Entries are identified by `proposer_pubkey`, so several proposers MAY submit to the same `url`.
- The beacon node routes each entry by its `url` and submits to that builder's
  `submitBuilderPreferences` for the entry's `proposer_pubkey`, forwarding the `auth` and
  `max_execution_payment`.
- Validators MAY submit in the epoch prior to proposing (from `state.proposer_lookahead`), so
  builders hold the preferences before the bid request arrives.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "proposer_pubkey": {},
    "url": "https://builder.example.com",
    "auth": {
      "message": {
        "data": "0x1234567890abcdef",
        "slot": {}
      },
      "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
    },
    "max_execution_payment": {}
  }
]
```

<h3 id="submit-builder-preferences-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|header|[ConsensusVersion](#schemaconsensusversion)|true|The active consensus version to which the submitted builder preferences belong.|
|body|body|[[Gloas.BuilderPreferencesEntry](#schemagloas.builderpreferencesentry)]|true|Array of `BuilderPreferencesEntry` objects to submit, one per builder per proposer.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Parameter|Value|
|---|---|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|phase0|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|altair|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|bellatrix|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|capella|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|deneb|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|electra|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|fulu|
|Eth-Consensus-Version|gloas|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "some failures",
  "failures": [
    {
      "index": 3,
      "message": "invalid signature"
    }
  ]
}
```

```json
  "code": 415,

}
```


## Indicates if a validator has been observed on the network

<a id="opIdgetLiveness"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/liveness/1 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    "1"
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/liveness/{epoch}`

Requests the beacon node to indicate if a validator has been observed to be live in a given epoch. The beacon node might detect liveness by observing messages from the validator on the network, in the beacon chain, from its API or from any other source. A beacon node SHOULD support the current and previous epoch, however it MAY support earlier epoch. It is important to note that the values returned by the beacon node are not canonical; they are best-effort and based upon a subjective view of the network. A beacon node that was recently started or suffered a network partition may indicate that a validator is not live when it actually is.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  "1"
]
```

<h3 id="indicates-if-a-validator-has-been-observed-on-the-network-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|epoch|path|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|The epoch for which liveness is being queried|
|body|body|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|An array of the validator indices for which to detect liveness.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "index": "1",
      "is_live": true
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid epoch: -2"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

## Get execution payload envelope

<a id="opIdgetExecutionPayloadEnvelope"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/execution_payload_envelopes/1/0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/validator/execution_payload_envelopes/{slot}/{beacon_block_root}`

Retrieves the cached execution payload envelope for the current proposer's slot, to be
signed and published via `publishExecutionPayloadEnvelope`.

The beacon node only caches the envelope for the current slot's locally built payload.
Requests for older slots or slots where no envelope has been cached will return a 404
error. This endpoint does not fetch payloads from the execution layer.

Depending on `Accept` header, the response can be returned either as JSON or as bytes serialized by SSZ.


<h3 id="get-execution-payload-envelope-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|path|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|Slot for which the execution payload envelope is requested.|
|beacon_block_root|path|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|Root of the beacon block associated with this execution payload envelope. The beacon<br>node will verify that the cached envelope matches the given block root, returning a<br>404 if there is no match. Requiring the block root makes the lookup re-org resistant:<br>if a re-org occurs between block production and envelope retrieval, the validator client<br>will receive a 404 rather than an envelope committed to a stale block.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "gloas",
  "data": {
    "payload": {
      "parent_hash": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",

      "block_number": "1",
      "gas_limit": "1",
      "gas_used": "1",
      "timestamp": "1",
      "extra_data": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
      "base_fee_per_gas": "1",
      "block_hash": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",

        "0x02f878831469668303f51d843b9ac9f9843b9aca0082520894c93269b73096998db66be0441e836d873535cb9c8894a19041886f000080c001a031cc29234036afbf9a1fb9476b463367cb1f957ac0b919b69bbc798436e604aaa018c4e9c3914eb27aadd0b91e10b18655739fcf8c1fc398763a9f1beecb8ddc86"
```

<h1 id="eth-beacon-node-api-validatorrequiredapi">ValidatorRequiredApi</h1>

Minimal set of endpoints to enable a working validator implementation.

## Get attester duties

<a id="opIdgetAttesterDuties"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/duties/attester/1 \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    "1"
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/duties/attester/{epoch}`

Requests the beacon node to provide a set of attestation duties, which should be performed by validators, for a particular epoch.
Duties should only need to be checked once per epoch, however a chain reorganization (of > MIN_SEED_LOOKAHEAD epochs) could occur, resulting in a change of duties. For full safety, you should monitor head_v2 events and confirm the dependent root in this response matches:
- event.current_epoch_dependent_root when `compute_epoch_at_slot(event.slot) == epoch`
- event.next_epoch_dependent_root when `compute_epoch_at_slot(event.slot) + 1 == epoch`

The dependent_root value is `get_block_root_at_slot(state, compute_start_slot_at_epoch(epoch - 1) - 1)` or the genesis block root in the case of underflow.

> Body parameter

```json
[
  "1"
]
```

<h3 id="get-attester-duties-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|epoch|path|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|Should only be allowed 1 epoch ahead|
|body|body|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|An array of the validator indices for which to obtain the duties.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "dependent_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
  "execution_optimistic": false,
  "data": [
    {
      "pubkey": "0x93247f2209abcacf57b75a51dafae777f9dd38bc7053d1af526f220a7489a6d3a2753e5f3e8b1cfe39b56f43611df74a",
      "validator_index": "1",
      "committee_index": "1",
      "committee_length": "1",
      "committees_at_slot": "1",
      "validator_committee_index": "1",
      "slot": "1"
    }
  ]
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "Invalid epoch: -2"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

<h3 id="get-attester-duties-responses">Responses</h3>

|Status|Meaning|Description|Schema|
|---|---|---|---|
|200|OK|Success response|Inline|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid epoch or index|[ErrorMessage](#schemaerrormessage)|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Beacon node is currently syncing, try again later.|Inline|

|---|---|---|---|---|

|execution_optimistic|[ExecutionOptimistic](#schemaexecutionoptimistic)|true|none|True if the response references an unverified execution payload. Optimistic information may be invalidated at a later time. If the field is not present, assume the False value.|
|data|[[AttesterDuty](#schemaattesterduty)]|true|none|none|

## Get block proposers duties

<a id="opIdgetProposerDuties"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/duties/proposer/1 \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/validator/duties/proposer/{epoch}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Request beacon node to provide all validators that are scheduled to propose a block in the given epoch.
Duties should only need to be checked once per epoch, however a chain reorganization could occur that results in a change of duties. For full safety, you should monitor head events and confirm the dependent root in this response matches:
- event.current_duty_dependent_root when `compute_epoch_at_slot(event.slot) == epoch`
- event.block otherwise

The dependent_root value is `get_block_root_at_slot(state, compute_start_slot_at_epoch(epoch) - 1)` or the genesis block root in the case of underflow.

## Produce a new block, without signature.

<a id="opIdproduceBlockV3"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v3/validator/blocks/1?randao_reveal=0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v3/validator/blocks/{slot}`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Requests a beacon node to produce a valid block, which can then be signed by a validator. The
returned block may be blinded or unblinded, depending on the current state of the network as
decided by the execution and beacon nodes.

The beacon node must return an unblinded block if it obtains the execution payload from its
paired execution node. It must only return a blinded block if it obtains the execution payload
header from an MEV relay.

Metadata in the response indicates the type of block produced.

This endpoint only supports forks through Fulu. Use `POST /eth/v4/validator/blocks/{slot}`
for Gloas and later forks.


<h3 id="produce-a-new-block-without-signature-1-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|path|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|The slot for which the block should be proposed.|
|randao_reveal|query|[Signature](#schemasignature)|true|The validator's randao reveal value.|
|graffiti|query|[Graffiti](#schemagraffiti)|false|Arbitrary data validator wants to include in block.|
|skip_randao_verification|query|string|false|Skip verification of the `randao_reveal` value. If this flag is set then the<br>`randao_reveal` must be set to the point at infinity (`0xc0..00`). <br>|
|builder_boost_factor|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|false|Percentage multiplier to apply to the builder's payload value when choosing between a<br>builder payload header and payload from the paired execution node. This parameter is only<br>relevant if the beacon node is connected to a builder, deems it safe to produce a builder<br>payload, and receives valid responses from both the builder endpoint _and_ the paired<br>execution node. When these preconditions are met, the server MUST act as follows:<br><br>* if `exec_node_payload_value >= builder_boost_factor * (builder_payload_value // 100)`,<br>  then return a full (unblinded) block containing the execution node payload.<br>* otherwise, return a blinded block containing the builder payload header.<br><br>Servers must support the following values of the boost factor which encode common<br>preferences:<br><br>* `builder_boost_factor=0`: prefer the local execution node payload unless an error makes it<br>  unviable.<br>* `builder_boost_factor=100`: profit maximization mode; choose whichever<br>  payload pays more.<br>* `builder_boost_factor=2**64 - 1`: prefer the external builder payload unless an error or<br>  beacon node health check makes it unviable.<br><br>Servers should use saturating arithmetic or another technique to ensure that large values of<br>the `builder_boost_factor` do not trigger overflows or errors. If this parameter is<br>provided and the beacon node is not configured with a builder then the beacon node MUST<br>respond with a full block, which the caller can choose to reject if it wishes.<br>If the value is provided but out of range for a 64-bit unsigned integer, then an error<br>response with status code 400 MUST be returned.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "fulu",
  "execution_payload_blinded": false,
  "execution_payload_value": "12345",
  "consensus_block_value": "12345",
  "data": {
    "block": {
```

### Response Headers

|Status|Header|Type|Format|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Version|string||The active consensus version to which the data belongs. Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data<br>more effectively.<br>|
|200|Eth-Execution-Payload-Blinded|boolean||Required in response so client can deserialize returned json or ssz data to the correct object.|
|200|Eth-Execution-Payload-Value|string||Execution payload value in Wei. Required in response so client can determine relative value<br>of execution payloads.<br>|
|200|Eth-Consensus-Block-Value|string||Consensus rewards for this block in Wei paid to the proposer. The<br>rewards value is the sum of values of the proposer rewards from<br>attestations, sync committees and slashings included in the proposal.<br>Required in response so client can determine relative value of<br>consensus blocks.<br>|

<aside class="success">
This operation does not require authentication
</aside>

## Produce an attestation data

<a id="opIdproduceAttestationData"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/attestation_data?slot=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/validator/attestation_data`

Requests that the beacon node produce an `AttestationData`.

For `slot`s in Electra and Fulu, this `AttestationData` must have an `index` of `0`.

For `slot`s in Gloas and later, the `index` in `AttestationData` is used to signal
payload availability which is determined and set by the beacon node.

A 503 error must be returned if the block identified by the response
`beacon_block_root` is optimistic (i.e. the attestation attests to a block
that has not been fully verified by an execution engine).


<h3 id="produce-an-attestation-data-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|The slot for which an attestation data should be created.|
|committee_index|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|false|**Deprecated.** The committee index for which an attestation data should be created. For `slot`s in<br>Electra and later, this parameter MAY always be set to 0.<br>For `slot`s in Gloas and later, this parameter SHOULD be omitted, as the Beacon node<br>SHOULD be setting the index based on network rules.<br>|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "data": {
    "slot": "1",
    "index": "0",
    "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
    "source": {
      "epoch": "1",
      "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
    },
    "target": {
      "epoch": "1",
      "root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2"
    }
  }
}
```

```json
  "code": 400,
  "message": "string",
  "stacktraces": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

```json
  "code": 406,
  "message": "Accepted media type not supported"
}
```

```json
}
```

## Produce payload attestation data

<a id="opIdproducePayloadAttestationData"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/payload_attestation_data?slot=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/validator/payload_attestation_data`

Requests that the beacon node produce a `PayloadAttestationData`.

This endpoint is used by PTC validators to obtain the data structure they need to attest to
regarding payload presence and blob data availability for a specific slot.

A 503 error must be returned if the beacon node is currently syncing.


<h3 id="produce-payload-attestation-data-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|The slot for which payload attestation data should be created.|

> Example responses

> 200 Response

```json
{
  "version": "gloas",
  "data": {
    "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
    "slot": "1",
    "payload_present": true,
    "blob_data_available": true
  }
}
```

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "string",
  "stacktraces": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

> 406 Response

```json
{
  "code": 406,
  "message": "Accepted media type not supported"
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

|400|Bad Request|Invalid request syntax.|Inline|
|406|Not Acceptable|Accepted media type is not supported.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|

## Get aggregated attestation

<a id="opIdgetAggregatedAttestationV2"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v2/validator/aggregate_attestation?attestation_data_root=0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2&slot=1&committee_index=1' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v2/validator/aggregate_attestation`

Aggregates all attestations matching given attestation data root, slot and committee index.

A 503 error must be returned if the block identified by the response
`beacon_block_root` is optimistic (i.e. the aggregated attestation attests
to a block that has not been fully verified by an execution engine).

A 404 error must be returned if no attestation is available for the requested
`attestation_data_root`.


<h3 id="get-aggregated-attestation-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attestation_data_root|query|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|HashTreeRoot of AttestationData that validator wants aggregated|
|slot|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|
|committee_index|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|

## Signal beacon node to prepare for a committee subnet

<a id="opIdprepareBeaconCommitteeSubnet"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/beacon_committee_subscriptions \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    {
      "validator_index": "1",
      "committee_index": "1",
      "committees_at_slot": "1",
      "slot": "1",
      "is_aggregator": true
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/beacon_committee_subscriptions`

After beacon node receives this request,
search using discv5 for peers related to this subnet
and replace current peers with those ones if necessary
If validator `is_aggregator`, beacon node must:
- announce subnet topic subscription on gossipsub
- aggregate attestations received on that subnet

Beacon nodes SHOULD use the set of validators that have submitted subscriptions via this
endpoint to determine which validators are using the node for duties and to calculate the
node's required custody group count (CGC). Validator clients SHOULD submit one entry per
attached active validator per attestation duty, including when multiple validators share
the same `(slot, committee_index)`, so the beacon node tracks every attached validator
rather than only one per subnet.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "validator_index": "1",
    "committee_index": "1",
    "committees_at_slot": "1",
    "slot": "1",
    "is_aggregator": true
  }
]
```

<h3 id="signal-beacon-node-to-prepare-for-a-committee-subnet-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[object]|true|none|
|» validator_index|body|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|
|» committee_index|body|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|
|» committees_at_slot|body|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|Number of committees at the returned slot|
|» slot|body|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|Should be slot at which validator is assigned to attest|
|» is_aggregator|body|boolean|true|Signals to BN that a validator on the VC has been chosen for aggregator role.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "string",
  "stacktraces": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

> 503 Response

```json
{
  "code": 503,
  "message": "Beacon node is currently syncing and not serving request on that endpoint"
}
```

|200|OK|Slot signature is valid and beacon node has prepared the attestation subnet.<br><br>Note that we cannot be certain the Beacon node will find peers for that subnet for various reasons.<br>|None|
|400|Bad Request|Invalid request syntax.|Inline|
|500|Internal Server Error|Beacon node internal error.|Inline|
|503|Service Unavailable|Beacon node is currently syncing, try again later.|Inline|

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/sync_committee_subscriptions \

    }

```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/sync_committee_subscriptions`

Subscribe to a number of sync committee subnets

Sync committees are not present in phase0, but are required for Altair networks.

Subscribing to sync committee subnets is an action performed by VC to enable network participation in Altair networks, and only required if the VC has an active validator in an active sync committee.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "validator_index": "1",
    "sync_committee_indices": [
      "1"
    ],
    "until_epoch": "1"
  }
]
```

## Produce a sync committee contribution

<a id="opIdproduceSyncCommitteeContribution"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl 'http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/sync_committee_contribution?slot=1&subcommittee_index=1&beacon_block_root=0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json'
```

`GET /eth/v1/validator/sync_committee_contribution`

Requests that the beacon node produce a sync committee contribution.

A 503 error must be returned if the block identified by the response
`beacon_block_root` is optimistic (i.e. the sync committee contribution
refers to a block that has not been fully verified by an execution engine).

A 404 error must be returned if no sync committee contribution is available
for the requested `beacon_block_root`.


<h3 id="produce-a-sync-committee-contribution-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|The slot for which a sync committee contribution should be created.|
|subcommittee_index|query|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|the subcommittee index for which to produce the contribution.|
|beacon_block_root|query|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|the block root for which to produce the contribution.|

```json
}
```

## Provide beacon node with proposals for the given validators.

<a id="opIdprepareBeaconProposer"></a>

> Code samples

```bash
curl http://localhost:5052/eth/v1/validator/prepare_beacon_proposer \
  -X POST \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -d '[
    {
      "validator_index": "1",
      "fee_recipient": "0xAbcF8e0d4e9587369b2301D0790347320302cc09"
    }
  ]'
```

`POST /eth/v1/validator/prepare_beacon_proposer`

<aside class="warning">
This operation is deprecated
</aside>

Deprecated from Gloas onwards in favor of
`POST /eth/v1/validator/proposer_preferences`, which supersedes both fee recipient and
gas limit preferences. Beacon node support for this endpoint pre-Gloas is REQUIRED;
post-Gloas support is OPTIONAL and the endpoint MAY be removed.

Prepares the beacon node for potential proposers by supplying information
required when proposing blocks for the given validators.  The information
supplied for each validator index will persist through the epoch in which
the call is submitted and for a further two epochs after that, or until the
beacon node restarts.  It is expected that validator clients will send this
information periodically, for example each epoch, to ensure beacon nodes have
correct and timely fee recipient information.

Note that there is no guarantee that the beacon node will use the supplied fee
recipient when creating a block proposal, so on receipt of a proposed block the
validator should confirm that it finds the fee recipient within the block
acceptable before signing it.

Also note that requests containing currently inactive or unknown validator
indices will be accepted, as they may become active at a later epoch.


> Body parameter

```json
[
  {
    "validator_index": "1",
    "fee_recipient": "0xAbcF8e0d4e9587369b2301D0790347320302cc09"
  }
]
```

<h3 id="provide-beacon-node-with-proposals-for-the-given-validators-parameters">Parameters</h3>

|Name|In|Type|Required|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|body|body|[object]|true|none|
|» validator_index|body|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|
|» fee_recipient|body|[ExecutionAddress](#schemaexecutionaddress)|true|An address on the execution (Ethereum 1) network.|

> Example responses

> 400 Response

```json
{
  "code": 400,
  "message": "string",
  "stacktraces": [
    "string"
  ]
}
```

> 500 Response

```json
{
  "code": 500,
  "message": "Internal server error"
}
```

<h2 id="tocS_ValidatorStatus">ValidatorStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemavalidatorstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_ValidatorStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSvalidatorstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsvalidatorstatus"></a>

```json
"active_ongoing"
```

Possible statuses:
- **pending_initialized** - When the first deposit is processed, but not enough funds are available (or not yet the end of the first epoch) to get validator into the activation queue.
- **pending_queued** - When validator is waiting to get activated, and have enough funds etc. while in the queue, validator activation epoch keeps changing until it gets to the front and make it through (finalization is a requirement here too).
- **active_ongoing** - When validator must be attesting, and have not initiated any exit.
- **active_exiting** - When validator is still active, but filed a voluntary request to exit.
- **active_slashed** - When validator is still active, but have a slashed status and is scheduled to exit.
- **exited_unslashed** - When validator has reached regular exit epoch, not being slashed, and doesn't have to attest any more, but cannot withdraw yet.
- **exited_slashed** - When validator has reached regular exit epoch, but was slashed, have to wait for a longer withdrawal period.
- **withdrawal_possible** - After validator has exited, a while later is permitted to move funds, and is truly out of the system.
- **withdrawal_done** - (not possible in phase0, except slashing full balance) - actually having moved funds away

[Validator status specification](https://hackmd.io/ofFJ5gOmQpu1jjHilHbdQQ)

<h2 id="tocS_BuilderStatus">BuilderStatus</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemabuilderstatus"></a>
<a id="schema_BuilderStatus"></a>
<a id="tocSbuilderstatus"></a>
<a id="tocsbuilderstatus"></a>

```json
"active"
```

Possible statuses:
- **pending** - When builder has not exited and is not yet active; `builder.withdrawable_epoch == FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH` and `is_active_builder(state, index)` returns `False`.
- **active** - When builder is active; `is_active_builder(state, index)` returns `True`, i.e. `builder.deposit_epoch < state.finalized_checkpoint.epoch` and `builder.withdrawable_epoch == FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH`.
- **exited** - When builder has exited; `builder.withdrawable_epoch != FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH`.
