<h2 id="tocS_ClientVersionV1">ClientVersionV1</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaclientversionv1"></a>
<a id="schema_ClientVersionV1"></a>
<a id="tocSclientversionv1"></a>
<a id="tocsclientversionv1"></a>

```json
{
  "code": "LS",
  "name": "Lodestar",
  "version": "v1.23.4",
  "commit": "0xfa4ff922"
}
```

A structure which uniquely identifies a client implementation and its version. Mirrors the client version specification in the [Engine API](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/dc4dbca37ef8697d782f431af19120beaf5517f5/src/engine/identification.md).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|code|string|true|none|A two-character client code that uniquely maps to a client name as defined in the [Engine API](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/blob/dc4dbca37ef8697d782f431af19120beaf5517f5/src/engine/identification.md#clientcode).|
|name|string|true|none|Human-readable name of the client, e.g. `Lighthouse` or `go-ethereum`.|
|version|string|true|none|The version string of the current implementation e.g. `v4.6.0` or `1.0.0-alpha.1` or `1.0.0+20130313144700`.|
|commit|string(hex)|true|none|4 bytes - first four bytes of the latest commit hash of this build e.g. `0xfa4ff922`.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|code|BU|
|code|EJ|
|code|EG|
|code|GE|
|code|GR|
|code|LH|
|code|LS|
|code|NM|
|code|NB|
|code|TE|
|code|TK|
|code|PM|
|code|RH|

The [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Bellatrix spec.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|proposer_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Index of validator in validator registry.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing Merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|state_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The tree hash Merkle root of the `BeaconState` for the `BeaconBlock`.|
|body|object|true|none|none|

A variant of the [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Bellatrix spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlockBody` rather than a `BeaconBlockBody`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|proposer_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Index of validator in validator registry.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing Merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|state_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The tree hash Merkle root of the `BeaconState` for the `BeaconBlock`.|
|body|object|true|none|A variant of the [`BeaconBlockBody`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/bellatrix/beacon-chain.md#beaconblockbody) object from the CL Bellatrix spec, which contains a transactions root rather than a full transactions list.|

A variant of the [`SignedBeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#signedbeaconblock) object envelope from the CL Bellatrix spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlock` rather than a `BeaconBlock`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message|[Bellatrix.BlindedBeaconBlock](#schemabellatrix.blindedbeaconblock)|true|none|A variant of the [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Bellatrix spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlockBody` rather than a `BeaconBlockBody`.|
|signature|[Signature](#schemasignature)|true|none|none|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|state_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Fixed length of 8192 items|

|randao_mixes|[string(hex)]|true|none|Fixed length of 65536 items|
|slashings|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|none|Per-epoch sums of slashed effective balances. Fixed length of 8192 items|

|current_epoch_participation|[string]|true|none|none|
|justification_bits|string(hex)|true|none|Bit set for every recent justified epoch|
|previous_justified_checkpoint|[Checkpoint](#schemacheckpoint)|true|none|The [`Checkpoint`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#checkpoint) object from the CL spec.|

|inactivity_scores|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|none|Per-validator inactivity scores. Introduced in Altair. Variable length list, maximum 1099511627776 items|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|

A variant of the [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Capella spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlockBody` rather than a `BeaconBlockBody`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|proposer_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Index of validator in validator registry.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing Merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|state_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The tree hash Merkle root of the `BeaconState` for the `BeaconBlock`.|
|body|object|true|none|A variant of the [`BeaconBlockBody`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/capella/beacon-chain.md#beaconblockbody) object from the CL Capella spec, which contains a transactions root rather than a full transactions list.|

|signature|[Signature](#schemasignature)|true|none|none|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genesis_time|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|

|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|

|latest_block_header|object|true|none|The [`BeaconBlockHeader`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblockheader) object from the CL spec.|
|block_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Fixed length of 8192 items|
|state_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Fixed length of 8192 items|
|historical_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Variable length list, maximum 16777216 items. Frozen in Capella, replaced by historical_summaries.|
|eth1_data|object|true|none|The [`Eth1Data`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#eth1data) object from the CL spec.|
|eth1_data_votes|[object]|true|none|Variable length list, maximum 2048 items.|
|eth1_deposit_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|
|validators|[object]|true|none|Variable length list, maximum 1099511627776 items|
|balances|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|none|Validator balances in gwei. Variable length list, maximum 1099511627776 items|
|randao_mixes|[string(hex)]|true|none|Fixed length of 65536 items|
|slashings|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|none|Per-epoch sums of slashed effective balances. Fixed length of 8192 items|
|previous_epoch_participation|[string]|true|none|none|
|current_epoch_participation|[string]|true|none|none|
|justification_bits|string(hex)|true|none|Bit set for every recent justified epoch|
|previous_justified_checkpoint|[Checkpoint](#schemacheckpoint)|true|none|The [`Checkpoint`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#checkpoint) object from the CL spec.|
|current_justified_checkpoint|[Checkpoint](#schemacheckpoint)|true|none|The [`Checkpoint`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#checkpoint) object from the CL spec.|
|finalized_checkpoint|[Checkpoint](#schemacheckpoint)|true|none|The [`Checkpoint`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#checkpoint) object from the CL spec.|
|inactivity_scores|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|none|Per-validator inactivity scores. Introduced in Altair. Variable length list, maximum 1099511627776 items|
|current_sync_committee|object|true|none|none|
|next_sync_committee|object|true|none|none|
|latest_execution_payload_header|object|true|none|The [`ExecutionPayloadHeader`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0/specs/deneb/beacon-chain.md#executionpayloadheader) object from the CL Deneb spec.|
|next_withdrawal_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|

The [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Deneb spec.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|proposer_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Index of validator in validator registry.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing Merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|state_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The tree hash Merkle root of the `BeaconState` for the `BeaconBlock`.|
|body|object|true|none|none|

A variant of the [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Deneb spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlockBody` rather than a `BeaconBlockBody`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|proposer_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Index of validator in validator registry.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing Merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|state_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The tree hash Merkle root of the `BeaconState` for the `BeaconBlock`.|
|body|object|true|none|A variant of the [`BeaconBlockBody`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0/specs/deneb/beacon-chain.md#beaconblockbody) object from the CL Deneb spec, which contains a transactions root rather than a full transactions list.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|genesis_time|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|

|latest_block_header|object|true|none|The [`BeaconBlockHeader`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.3.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblockheader) object from the CL spec.|
|block_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Fixed length of 8192 items|
|state_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Fixed length of 8192 items|
|historical_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Variable length list, maximum 16777216 items. Frozen in Capella, replaced by historical_summaries.|

|validators|[object]|true|none|Variable length list, maximum 1099511627776 items|

|randao_mixes|[string(hex)]|true|none|Fixed length of 65536 items|

|justification_bits|string(hex)|true|none|Bit set for every recent justified epoch|

|inactivity_scores|[[Uint64](#schemauint64)]|true|none|Per-validator inactivity scores. Introduced in Altair. Variable length list, maximum 1099511627776 items|
|current_sync_committee|object|true|none|none|
|next_sync_committee|object|true|none|none|
|latest_execution_payload_header|object|true|none|The [`ExecutionPayloadHeader`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.4.0/specs/deneb/beacon-chain.md#executionpayloadheader) object from the CL Deneb spec.|
|next_withdrawal_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|

A variant of the [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.5.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Electra spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlockBody` rather than a `BeaconBlockBody`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|proposer_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Index of validator in validator registry.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing Merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|state_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The tree hash Merkle root of the `BeaconState` for the `BeaconBlock`.|
|body|object|true|none|A variant of the [`BeaconBlockBody`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.5.0/specs/electra/beacon-chain.md#beaconblockbody) object from the CL Electra spec, which contains a transactions root rather than a full transactions list.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|message|[Electra.BlindedBeaconBlock](#schemaelectra.blindedbeaconblock)|true|none|A variant of the [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.5.0/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Electra spec, which contains a `BlindedBeaconBlockBody` rather than a `BeaconBlockBody`.|
|signature|[Signature](#schemasignature)|true|none|none|

|state_roots|[[Root](#schemaroot)]|true|none|Fixed vector of 8192 roots.|

The [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Gloas spec.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|proposer_index|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Index of validator in validator registry.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing Merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|state_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The tree hash Merkle root of the `BeaconState` for the `BeaconBlock`.|
|body|object|true|none|The [`BeaconBlockBody`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#beaconblockbody) object from the CL Gloas spec.|

The [`Builder`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#builder) object from the CL Gloas spec.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|pubkey|string(hex)|true|none|The validator's BLS public key, uniquely identifying them. _48-bytes, hex encoded with 0x prefix, case insensitive._|
|version|string|true|none|Builder version.|
|execution_address|[ExecutionAddress](#schemaexecutionaddress)|true|none|Execution-layer address that receives builder withdrawals.|
|balance|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Current builder balance in gwei.|
|deposit_epoch|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Epoch when the builder deposit was processed.|
|withdrawable_epoch|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Epoch when the builder can withdraw. 'FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH' if not exiting.|

Block contents for self-building, including the execution payload envelope
and blobs. This enables stateless failover to another beacon node for publishing,
as all required data is returned in a single response.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|block|[Gloas.BeaconBlock](#schemagloas.beaconblock)|true|none|The [`BeaconBlock`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/phase0/beacon-chain.md#beaconblock) object from the CL Gloas spec.|
|execution_payload_envelope|[Gloas.ExecutionPayloadEnvelope](#schemagloas.executionpayloadenvelope)|true|none|The [`ExecutionPayloadEnvelope`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#executionpayloadenvelope) object from the CL Gloas spec.|
|kzg_proofs|[string(hex)]|true|none|none|
|blobs|[Blobs](#schemablobs)|true|none|none|

Signed execution payload envelope bundled with blobs and KZG proofs for stateless
publishing. Used when the validator client publishes to a beacon node that does not
have the blobs cached (e.g. multi-BN setups, distributed validators, failover).

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|signed_execution_payload_envelope|[Gloas.SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope](#schemagloas.signedexecutionpayloadenvelope)|true|none|The [`SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#signedexecutionpayloadenvelope) object from the CL Gloas spec.|
|kzg_proofs|[string(hex)]|true|none|none|
|blobs|[Blobs](#schemablobs)|true|none|none|

```json
{
  "beacon_block_root": "0xcf8e0d4e9587369b2301d0790347320302cc0943d5a1884560367e8208d920f2",
  "slot": "1",
  "payload_present": true,
  "blob_data_available": true
}
```

The [`PayloadAttestationData`](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/v1.7.0-beta.3/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md#payloadattestationdata) object from the CL Gloas spec.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|beacon_block_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|Hash tree root of the beacon block associated with this PTC attestation|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot for which the payload attestation is being made|
|payload_present|boolean|true|none|True if a `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope` has been seen referencing this block|
|blob_data_available|boolean|true|none|True if blob data is available for this block|

|committee_bits|string(hex)|true|none|Committee bits, a fixed vector of MAX_COMMITTEES_PER_SLOT (64) bits.|

|target_gas_limit|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Preferred gas limit for the execution payload.|


The [`BuilderRequestAuth`](https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/specs/gloas/validator.md#builderrequestauth) object from the Builder API Gloas spec.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|data|string(hex)|true|none|Opaque authentication data unique to the builder, agreed upon out of band. The meaning of<br>the up to `MAX_BUILDER_AUTH_DATA_SIZE` (4096) bytes is left to the two parties; the builder checks the<br>exact bytes when it verifies. When no value has been agreed out of band, implementations<br>SHOULD default to the builder's hostname derived from its URL, see<br>[default auth data](https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/blob/main/specs/gloas/validator.md#default-auth-data),<br>so proposers with no prior relationship can construct an identical `data`<br>deterministically. A zero-length `data` is invalid.<br>|
|slot|object|true|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_Gloas.BuilderEntry">Gloas.BuilderEntry</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagloas.builderentry"></a>
<a id="schema_Gloas.BuilderEntry"></a>
<a id="tocSgloas.builderentry"></a>
<a id="tocsgloas.builderentry"></a>

```json
{
  "url": "https://builder.example.com",
  "auth": {
    "message": {
      "data": "0x1234567890abcdef",
      "slot": {}
    },
    "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  },
  "builder_pubkeys": [
    {}
  ],
  "max_execution_payment": {},
  "min_bid": {},
  "builder_boost_factor": {}
}
```

A per-builder input the validator client supplies on a block-production request.

Each entry is a bid request sent to its `url`, authenticated by its `auth`, which the
builder requires on every request. No two entries may share both their `url` and their
`auth`'s `data`, and one request is made per entry, so several MAY share a `url` with
different `data`.

`auth` is the `SignedBuilderRequestAuth` object from the Builder API Gloas spec.

A `BuilderEntry` never reaches a builder, so it has no Builder API definition. Its SSZ
container and constants are:

    MAX_BUILDER_ENTRIES = 64
    MAX_BUILDER_URL_SIZE = 2048
    MAX_BUILDER_PUBKEYS = 64

    class BuilderEntry(Container):
        url: ByteList[MAX_BUILDER_URL_SIZE]  # UTF-8 bytes of `url`, exactly as in JSON
        auth: SignedBuilderRequestAuth
        builder_pubkeys: List[BLSPubkey, MAX_BUILDER_PUBKEYS]
        max_execution_payment: Gwei
        min_bid: Gwei
        builder_boost_factor: uint64

In either encoding, a zero-length `url` is invalid.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|Where this entry's bid request is sent.|
|auth|object|true|none|none|
|builder_pubkeys|[object]|true|none|The builder BLS public keys this entry accepts bids from. Empty accepts any builder; otherwise a bid not signed by one of them MUST NOT be accepted.|
|max_execution_payment|object|true|none|none|
|min_bid|object|true|none|none|
|builder_boost_factor|object|true|none|none|

<h2 id="tocS_Gloas.BuilderConfig">Gloas.BuilderConfig</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagloas.builderconfig"></a>
<a id="schema_Gloas.BuilderConfig"></a>
<a id="tocSgloas.builderconfig"></a>
<a id="tocsgloas.builderconfig"></a>

```json
{
  "min_bid": {},
  "builder_boost_factor": {},
  "builders": [
    {
      "url": "https://builder.example.com",
      "auth": {
        "message": {
          "data": "0x1234567890abcdef",
          "slot": {}
        },
        "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
      },
      "builder_pubkeys": [
        {}
      ],
      "max_execution_payment": {},
      "min_bid": {},
      "builder_boost_factor": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

The resolved per-key builder config the validator client sends on a block-production request.
Entries arrive fully resolved, so a requested bid is governed by its own `BuilderEntry`; the
top-level `min_bid` and `builder_boost_factor` apply to bids received over p2p.

Its SSZ container is:

    class BuilderConfig(Container):
        min_bid: Gwei
        builder_boost_factor: uint64
        builders: List[BuilderEntry, MAX_BUILDER_ENTRIES]

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|min_bid|object|true|none|none|
|builder_boost_factor|object|true|none|none|
|builders|[[Gloas.BuilderEntry](#schemagloas.builderentry)]|true|none|The builders to request bids from, one `BuilderEntry` each. Empty means request none, so only p2p bids are considered.|

<h2 id="tocS_Gloas.BuilderPreferencesEntry">Gloas.BuilderPreferencesEntry</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemagloas.builderpreferencesentry"></a>
<a id="schema_Gloas.BuilderPreferencesEntry"></a>
<a id="tocSgloas.builderpreferencesentry"></a>
<a id="tocsgloas.builderpreferencesentry"></a>

```json
{
  "proposer_pubkey": {},
  "url": "https://builder.example.com",
  "auth": {
    "message": {
      "data": "0x1234567890abcdef",
      "slot": {}
    },
    "signature": "0x1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505cc411d61252fb6cb3fa0017b679f8bb2305b26a285fa2737f175668d0dff91cc1b66ac1fb663c9bc59509846d6ec05345bd908eda73e670af888da41af171505"
  },
  "max_execution_payment": {}
}
```

A per-builder preference the validator client asks the beacon node to submit ahead of the bid
request, one entry per builder per proposer. A single submission batches these across the
validator client's proposers, so each entry names the proposer it belongs to in
`proposer_pubkey`. It is a dedicated type, distinct from the block-production `BuilderEntry`.

The entry pairs the beacon node's routing with the payload the builder receives, so like
`BuilderEntry` it has no Builder API definition. Its SSZ container uses that type's constants
and the `SignedBuilderRequestAuth` object from the Builder API Gloas spec:

    class BuilderPreferencesEntry(Container):
        proposer_pubkey: BLSPubkey  # the proposer these preferences belong to
        url: ByteList[MAX_BUILDER_URL_SIZE]  # UTF-8 bytes of `url`, exactly as in JSON
        auth: SignedBuilderRequestAuth
        max_execution_payment: Gwei

In either encoding, a zero-length `url` is invalid.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|proposer_pubkey|object|true|none|The BLS public key of the proposer these preferences apply to.|
|url|string(uri)|true|none|The URL this entry's preferences are submitted to. Multiple entries MAY share a `url`; the beacon node makes one submission per entry.|
|auth|object|true|none|Authenticates this submission to the builder. The beacon node MUST forward `message` and `signature` byte-for-byte unchanged.|
|max_execution_payment|object|true|none|none|

fork choice node attributes

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot to which this block corresponds.|
|block_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing merkle root of the `BeaconBlock`.|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The signing merkle root of the parent `BeaconBlock`.|
|justified_epoch|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|
|finalized_epoch|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|
|weight|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|none|

|execution_block_hash|string(hex)|true|none|The `block_hash` from the `execution_payload` of the `BeaconBlock`|
|extra_data|[ExtraData](#schemaextradata)|false|none|Extra data that may differ between clients, or an empty object if none is provided.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|validity|valid|
|validity|invalid|
|validity|optimistic|

```json
  "payload_data_availability_yes_count": "1",

```

A fork choice node, identified by its block root and payload status.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|slot|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The slot of the beacon block.|
|block_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The hash tree root of the beacon block.|
|payload_status|string|true|none|- `pending`: the parent of this block's `empty` and `full` nodes. This node remains after the payload is received.<br>- `empty`: the node representing this block without its execution payload, even if the payload has been received.<br>- `full`: the node representing this block with its execution payload.<br>|
|parent_root|[Root](#schemaroot)|true|none|The block root of the parent fork choice node. For Gloas `empty` and `full` nodes, this equals<br>`block_root`, pointing to the same block's `pending` node. Otherwise, it is the beacon block's `parent_root`.<br>|
|parent_payload_status|null \| string|true|none|The payload status of the parent fork choice node. Null if the parent is not retained in the fork choice tree.|
|justified_checkpoint|[Checkpoint](#schemacheckpoint)|true|none|The justified checkpoint recorded for this fork choice node.|
|finalized_checkpoint|[Checkpoint](#schemacheckpoint)|true|none|The finalized checkpoint recorded for this fork choice node.|
|weight|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|The raw stored weight of this fork choice node in Gwei.|
|validity|string|true|none|The execution validity of the chain ending at `execution_block_hash`.|
|execution_block_hash|string(hex)|true|none|For `full` nodes, the block's execution payload hash. For Gloas `pending` and `empty` nodes,<br>the bid's `parent_block_hash`.<br>|
|payload_attester_count|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Number of PTC positions with a recorded vote.|
|payload_availability_yes_count|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Number of PTC positions voting that the payload was received on time.|
|payload_data_availability_yes_count|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|Number of PTC positions voting that the blob data is available.|
|extra_data|[ExtraData](#schemaextradata)|true|none|Extra data that may differ between clients, or an empty object if none is provided.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|payload_status|pending|
|payload_status|empty|
|payload_status|full|
|validity|valid|
|validity|invalid|
|validity|optimistic|

Rewards info for a single block

### Properties

|---|---|---|---|---|

|attestations|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|block reward component due to included attestations in gwei|
|sync_aggregate|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|block reward component due to included sync_aggregate in gwei|
|proposer_slashings|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|block reward component due to included proposer_slashings in gwei|
|attester_slashings|[Uint64](#schemauint64)|true|none|block reward component due to included attester_slashings in gwei|
